Title: Revenue Analytics Engineer
Description:
Context & Impact

As Lansweeper scales its SaaS business across new products and markets, revenue analytics has become a critical function for steering executive and board-level decisions. This role exists to bring structure, trust, and clarity to how Lansweeper measures and understands its revenue.

You will be the dedicated Revenue Analytics Engineer within a 10-person Data & Analytics team — the first hire focused entirely on revenue — reporting directly to the Data Platform Manager. Your work will directly shape how C-level leaders and the board understand growth, and how sales and finance teams plan and act.

In the near term, your goals are to establish a single source of truth for revenue KPIs, build board-ready reporting, and deliver forecasting models that drive go-to-market decisions.

Challenge

The Main Challenges You'll Face Are


Speed vs. complexity: The sales organization moves fast and needs reliable revenue facts quickly — but revenue data is sourced from multiple systems (CRM, billing, ERP) with historic complexity from acquisitions and system migrations, and data quality that varies over time.
Keeping up with a changing business:** As Lansweeper's product and market evolve, sales and marketing allocation must follow. You'll need to continuously adapt revenue models to reflect new business processes and priorities.
Being the first and only:** You are the sole analytics engineer focused on revenue. You'll need to build foundations from scratch, establish trust in the numbers, and earn your seat at the table with finance and executive stakeholders — all at the same time.


Key Responsibilities


Build, maintain, and improve revenue data models** that power executive-level reporting and board-ready metrics across ARR, MRR, churn, expansion, contraction, and renewal cycles
Reconcile revenue data across systems of record** — CRM, billing, and ERP — and establish a single, trusted source of truth for financial KPIs
Design and deliver dashboards and reports** that translate complex revenue data into clear, actionable insights for sales, finance, and leadership
Partner with sales operations and finance** to understand evolving business processes and reflect them accurately in revenue analytics models
Develop and maintain forecasting models** for key revenue metrics to support go-to-market planning and strategic decision-making
Investigate and explain trends, anomalies, and shifts** in revenue data, linking them back to underlying sales and finance drivers
Proactively improve data quality and integrity** across revenue-related data pipelines to ensure consistent, reliable reporting


Key Requirements

Hard Skills


Financial metrics reporting — solid understanding of how revenue, bookings, churn, ARR, MRR, expansion, contraction, and renewal KPIs are defined and measured in a SaaS context
Strong SQL skills — ability to write, optimize, and debug complex queries against large datasets
Systems reconciliation — hands-on experience resolving data mismatches between CRM, billing, and finance systems to produce a reliable single source of truth
Data modelling — familiarity with best practices such as dimensional modelling and slowly changing dimensions; experience with Snowflake and dbt is a strong plus
Dashboard and reporting delivery— experience building clear, business-facing reports; experience with **Power BI** is a strong plus


Soft Skills


Analytical storytelling — you translate data into business narratives that support decisions, not just numbers on a screen
Stakeholder collaboration— you work confidently with finance, sales ops, and executive audiences, adapting your communication to each
Ownership mindset — you take initiative, work independently, and drive outcomes without waiting to be directed


AI-Specific Skills

Lansweeper is an AI-native company. In this role, AI fluency is a hard requirement — not a nice-to-have.

You are expected to use AI tooling as a standard part of your day-to-day workflow: this includes AI-assisted SQL generation and debugging, using AI to accelerate data modelling and anomaly investigation, and leveraging AI features within your analytics stack (such as Snowflake Cortex or dbt-integrated tooling). You should be comfortable prompting AI tools effectively, evaluating their outputs critically, and integrating AI into repeatable workflows — from data pipeline development to generating draft narrative summaries for executive reporting. General AI fluency across platforms such as ChatGPT or Copilot is expected.

Team Info

You'll join the Insights & Intelligence team, part of the broader Data & Analytics function at Lansweeper. The team has 10 people and is led by the **Data Platform Manager**, who you will report to directly. You will work closely with sales operations, finance, and data engineers across the organization.

As the **only analytics engineer focused on revenue**, you will own this domain end-to-end — a rare opportunity to define how a growing SaaS company understands and steers its revenue.

The team is based across Ghent, Belgium and Alicante, Spain, with a hybrid working model at both locations.

Our Offer

Salary

See Pay Transparency section below.

Benefits — Belgium


Meal vouchers
Eco vouchers
Hospitalisation insurance
Group insurance
Company car or mobility budget
Phone plan
Internet allowance


Benefits — Spain


Health insurance
Meal allowance
Flexible remuneration plan


What Else You Get


A high-impact, high-autonomy role at the intersection of data, finance, and go-to-market strategy
Hybrid working from either **Ghent, Belgium or Alicante, Spain** — flexibility built in by design
A pragmatic, collaborative data team that values ownership and real-world impact over process for process's sake
The opportunity to **build the revenue analytics function from the ground up** in a scaling SaaS company
A front-row seat to C-level and board decision-making, with your work directly influencing strategic direction


About Lansweeper

Lansweeper is the AI Cyber Asset Intelligence platform helping IT and Security teams gain full visibility, reduce cyber risk, and scale automation with confidence.

In today's complex IT, OT, cloud, and IoT environments, fragmented asset data slows decisions and increases risk. We transform raw asset data into a continuously validated, trusted source of truth — so teams can move faster and act with certainty.

With Lansweeper, Organizations Can

See – Truly complete visibility across hybrid environments

Know– Enriched asset intelligence with lifecycle and risk context

Act – Automate workflows, coordinate remediation, and enforce policy at scale

From universal asset discovery to AI-powered intelligence, we provide the shared foundation modern IT Operations, Cybersecurity, and Digital Transformation teams rely on.

Our Culture — Built On Four Core Values


One Team – United across boundaries
We Care – Customers and people at the centre
We Grow – Learning, sharing, improving
We Deliver – Focusing on what truly matters


Pay Transparency

At Lansweeper, every role is assigned to a level defined by three things: the expertise it requires, the complexity it involves, and the scope of impact it carries.

Each level maps to a salary band based on salary benchmarks from the Software/SaaS industry of your country, so your pay reflects what the market pays for comparable roles.

The gross salary range for this role is €107,000 – €174,000 (EUR) (Belgium) or €75,000 – €123,000 (EUR) (Spain) (based on full-time employment).

Where you land within that range depends on the expertise you bring, the complexity you have navigated, the scope of impact you have owned, and your track record of delivering results in comparable roles — the same criteria applied consistently to every candidate.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, religion, ethnic origin, age, sexual orientation, or disability.

How AI Is Used During The Hiring Process

We use AI to support and not replace during the hiring process. HR decisions are made by our talent acquisition team. You can request more info at any time via [email protected]

It is Lansweeper's policy to provide equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees.

Lansweeper disapproves of, and will not tolerate, unlawful discrimination against any applicant or employee because of race, color, national origin or ancestry, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity, age, religion, disability, family care status, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws.

Title: Internal Auditor - Data Analyst in Credit Models
Description:
Your job in a nutshell

Are you a data-savvy professional, passionate about turning raw data into actionable insights?

As an Internal Auditor - Data Analyst in the Internal Credit Models Audit Team of Inspection Générale (IG) Hub Brussels, Factor you will play a crucial role in supporting management and audit teams by participating in audit missions with a focus on data mining and analysis. You will contribute to credit models deep-dive assignments through data analytics and help evaluate the effectiveness of governance, risk management and control processes.

This is a role for a practical, hands-on data professional who enjoys ensuring processes run reliably as much as building new solutions.




And in detail

You analyze and document business processes, leveraging on the use of related business and credit models data, and contribute to their continuous improvement;
You support the audit teams to translate audit objectives into data requirements, and to extract data from data warehouses and operational systems, transforming data and preparing it for analysis in the context of credit model reviews and deep-dive audit work.
You provide meaningful data insights, through advanced data mining and analytics, ensuring data is fit for purpose for audit and deep-dive review activities.
You develop, enhance and maintain solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate), SAS and Python to support audit analytics and the review of internal credit models.




Your skills and strengths

You have a strong analytical mindset.
You have a proven experience, or a strong academic background, in data analytics or data engineering, ideally complemented by exposure to model development, model validation or related audit work.
You are interested in learning the bank’s data platforms and you have strong hands-on experience with data tools, enabling you to work effectively on datasets used in model analysis and audit testing.
You have a solid understanding of data governance, quality, and security management principles.
You have a strong expertise in the use of Microsoft Power Platforms: Power BI (data modelling, DAX, dashboard development), Power Automate (workflow automation), PowerApps (basic application development and support).
Experience with Python, BI4 and SAS for data transformation and analysis is a strong plus, particularly for audit analytics and model-related data investigations.




Furthermore

You can use English as a working language for both verbal and written communication. Additionally, you are fluent in one of our national languages (French or Dutch) and have a very good knowledge of the other.
You have a master's degree.
You have strong problem-solving skills, and you pay attention to details.
You work autonomously, manage priorities and respect deadlines.
You have excellent organizational skills, and you are able to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
You proactively and enthusiastically contribute as a team player with a professional, result-driven, and client-oriented approach.
You are entrepreneurial and continuously seek improvement.




What can we offer you?

A permanent contract and an attractive remuneration package.
In addition to your remuneration and benefits (meal vouchers, insurance, Bank holidays), we offer flexible salary options, allowing you to convert part of your salary into personalized benefits (phone use, IT equipment, transport, etc.).




Our impact

As a company, we implement concrete and sustainable solutions to reduce our environmental footprint, such as saving paper and resources, recycling our waste, encouraging the use of green transport, occupying buildings that are designed and managed to limit our impact, etc.

Your prospects

We offer a wide range of training courses, workshops and webinars to choose from depending on your availability, interests and goals.

Let's share our values:

At BNP Paribas Fortis, we surround ourselves with talented people, regardless of their gender or gender identity, their age, their origin, their sexual orientation, their disability... And to guarantee equal opportunities for everyone, whatever their personal or family commitments, our full-time job offers are also open to part-time employees, at 80% or 90%.




Ready to seize this opportunity?

We will make an initial selection based on your CV and cover letter. We will contact you if your profile matches our vacancy.

Good luck!

If this function does not meet your expectations or profile, please feel free to share it with others.

And in detail

  • You analyze and document business processes, leveraging on the use of related business and credit models data, and contribute to their continuous improvement;
  • You support the audit teams to translate audit objectives into data requirements, and to extract data from data warehouses and operational systems, transforming data and preparing it for analysis in the context of credit model reviews and deep-dive audit work.
  • You provide meaningful data insights, through advanced data mining and analytics, ensuring data is fit for purpose for audit and deep-dive review activities.
  • You develop, enhance and maintain solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate), SAS and Python to support audit analytics and the review of internal credit models.


Your skills and strengths

  • You have a strong analytical mindset.
  • You have a proven experience, or a strong academic background, in data analytics or data engineering, ideally complemented by exposure to model development, model validation or related audit work.
  • You are interested in learning the bank’s data platforms and you have strong hands-on experience with data tools, enabling you to work effectively on datasets used in model analysis and audit testing.
  • You have a solid understanding of data governance, quality, and security management principles.
  • You have a strong expertise in the use of Microsoft Power Platforms: Power BI (data modelling, DAX, dashboard development), Power Automate (workflow automation), PowerApps (basic application development and support).
  • Experience with Python, BI4 and SAS for data transformation and analysis is a strong plus, particularly for audit analytics and model-related data investigations.


Furthermore

  • You can use English as a working language for both verbal and written communication. Additionally, you are fluent in one of our national languages (French or Dutch) and have a very good knowledge of the other.
  • You have a master's degree.
  • You have strong problem-solving skills, and you pay attention to details.
  • You work autonomously, manage priorities and respect deadlines.
  • You have excellent organizational skills, and you are able to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • You proactively and enthusiastically contribute as a team player with a professional, result-driven, and client-oriented approach.
  • You are entrepreneurial and continuously seek improvement.


What can we offer you?

  • A permanent contract and an attractive remuneration package.
  • In addition to your remuneration and benefits (meal vouchers, insurance, Bank holidays), we offer flexible salary options, allowing you to convert part of your salary into personalized benefits (phone use, IT equipment, transport, etc.).


Our impact

As a company, we implement concrete and sustainable solutions to reduce our environmental footprint, such as saving paper and resources, recycling our waste, encouraging the use of green transport, occupying buildings that are designed and managed to limit our impact, etc.

We offer a wide range of training courses, workshops and webinars to choose from depending on your availability, interests and goals.

At BNP Paribas Fortis, we surround ourselves with talented people, regardless of their gender or gender identity, their age, their origin, their sexual orientation, their disability... And to guarantee equal opportunities for everyone, whatever their personal or family commitments, our full-time job offers are also open to part-time employees, at 80% or 90%.


Ready to seize this opportunity?

We will make an initial selection based on your CV and cover letter. We will contact you if your profile matches our vacancy.

Good luck!

Title: Data Analyst - Legacy, Mainframe & Datamigratie (In dienst of freelance)
Description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Presentatie

Je komt terecht in een complexe ICT-omgeving binnen de publieke sector, waar informatiesystemen en digitale processen verder worden gemoderniseerd.

Project

Voor de verdere digitale transformatie en de afbouw van mainframegebaseerde toepassingen zoeken we een Business / Functional / Technical Data Analyst. Je analyseert bestaande domeinen, gegevensmodellen, functies, processen en bevragingen en vertaalt die naar een moderne, toekomstgerichte ICT-omgeving. Daarbij gaat bijzondere aandacht naar datamigratie, semantische modellering, ontologieën en de analyse van centrale logging.

Missie


Je analyseert bestaande mainframetoepassingen, legacy-omgevingen, gegevensstructuren, gegevensstromen en functionele processen.
Je brengt businesslogica, gegevensdefinities, businessregels, afhankelijkheden en bevragingen in kaart.
Je vertaalt bestaande functionaliteit naar nieuwe processen, datamodellen, integratieconcepten en een moderne architectuur.
Je voert datamapping en impactanalyses uit in het kader van migraties naar nieuwe platformen.
Je werkt mee aan datamodellering, semantische modellering en het opzetten van ontologieën en semantische modellen.
Je analyseert logging, audittrails, exploitatiegegevens en de werking van centrale analyse- en loggingtools.
Je ondersteunt de migratie van toepassingen, processen en gegevens vanuit legacy-omgevingen.
Je documenteert processen, gegevensmodellen en businessregels en staat mee in voor de functionele validatie van gemigreerde processen en gegevens.
Je stemt af met businessgebruikers, architecten, ontwikkelaars, databasebeheerders, securityspecialisten en projectverantwoordelijken, en faciliteert workshops met domeinexperten.



Soft skills


Sterk analytisch vermogen
Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatie
Je slaat de brug tussen business, data, architectuur en technologie
Methodisch en nauwkeurig werken
Kritisch denkvermogen
Zelfstandig en proactief
Teamspeler in een multidisciplinaire omgeving
Oplossingsgericht en constructief ingesteld
Stressbestendig
Focus op kwaliteit, traceerbaarheid, beveiliging en herbruikbaarheid



In de praktijk

Je werkt vanuit Brussel in een multidisciplinair team van interne en externe medewerkers. Afhankelijk van de taken is aanwezigheid op kantoor minstens twee keer per week voorzien, in overleg met het team. Telewerk is mogelijk vanuit België.

Jouw profiel

Je hebt ervaring als functioneel analist op medior niveau en voelt je thuis in data-intensieve migratie- en moderniseringstrajecten.


Ervaring met businessanalyse en functionele analyse
Kennis van legacy- en mainframeomgevingen
Ervaring met datamapping en impactanalyse
Ervaring met datamodellering en semantische modellering
Inzicht in ontologieën en semantische modellen
Ervaring met de analyse van logging, audittrails en exploitatiegegevens
Vaardigheid in het documenteren van processen, gegevensmodellen en businessregels
Ervaring met domeinanalyse binnen complexe organisaties
Kennis van functionele validatie van gemigreerde processen en gegevens
Affiniteit met migratie van toepassingen, processen en gegevens naar nieuwe platformen
Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands, Frans en Engels



Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

(Freelance is ook mogelijk)

Title: Data Analyst Consultant
Description:
Morrison Finance is a European-based leading consultancy company. We are seeking a skilled Data Analyst Consultant to work within the Program Management Life Department of one of our blue chip client in insurance industry. This team is crucial for managing projects and tools that enhance the efficiency of operational activities. A key challenge they face is effectively managing and representing increasing volumes of data.

The cconsultant will support a newly launched workflow tool that requires expertise in Power BI to gather and visualize the necessary information for Operations teams. The role will involve several upcoming projects where data collection, analysis, and the presentation of insights will be essential for maintaining focus and driving performance.

Collaboration with Operations departments and IT colleagues is vital, as reconciling diverse interests will be a significant aspect of the role. We are looking for a Data Analyst and Power BI expert who will translate operational data into analytical models, elevate the data skills of team members, and play a pivotal role in conceptualizing data architecture.




Key Responsibilities:

Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand data needs and provide tailored solutions.
Gather, analyze, and interpret complex data sets to deliver actionable insights.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports to visualize data and support informed decision-making.
Ensure data quality and integrity through regular verifications and validation processes.
Propose and implement initiatives to enhance awareness of data analytics within the department.
Identify and implement analytics models based on operational data.
Support and mentor one or two colleagues in the Process & Organisation team.
Assist in establishing the conceptual architecture for data management.
Apply AI solutions to improve the creation of sophisticated and insightful Power BI dashboards.




Required Knowledge and Experience




Personal Skills (Soft Skills):

Structured, conscientious, and flexible
Hands-on approach
Excellent communication skills
Team player
Critical and analytical thinking
Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines
Strong documentation skills
Awareness of technological trends in the BI field




Business Experience Required :

Senior profile with concrete experience in data analysis and Power BI
Deep understanding of data analytics and visualization techniques
Experience in the insurance or financial industry




Technical Experience Required:

Proficiency in MS Office 365
Mastery of Power BI, including advanced features like Power Query and DAX
Data analysis and modeling skills
Expertise in data visualization techniques

Preferable:

Knowledge of Python
Familiarity with Copilot M365
Experience with time series modeling (e.g., ARIMA) in Power BI
Understanding of Azure Cognitive Services




Level of Education

Master’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or Business), with an emphasis on data analysis.




Language Requirement

Native-level proficiency in Dutch and French, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Fluent in English




What We Offer:

Being part of a dynamic, energetic, and opportunity-filled company
Gaining valuable professional experience within a fast-growing company
Continuous learning, with extensive training in both technical and soft skills
A workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and free to be themselves
Inspiring and supportive colleagues
Forward-looking, highly accessible leadership
A flexible work schedule
An attractive salary and benefits package

Title: Data scientist _FR
Description:
Comment pouvez-vous faire la différence ?

En tant que Data scientist – dans le service Corporate strategy, vous développez et maintenez des modèles stratégiques qui fournissent des insights approfondis et qui contribuent directement aux choix politiques et aux décisions d’investissement.

Vous travaillez à l’intersection des données, du business et de la stratégie et vous veillez à ce que des hypothèses et calculs complexes soient implémentés de manière transparente, robuste et reproductible dans des solutions de données évolutives.

Vous intégrez une équipe agile où PySpark occupe une place centrale dans le développement de solutions data. Nous travaillons avec Azure Databricks, Azure DevOps et VS Code. La collaboration, le partage de connaissance et la qualité sont essentiels.

Quel est votre rôle à la SNCB ?

En tant que Data scientist, vous aurez les responsabilités suivantes :


Vous développez, maintenez et industrialisez des modèles stratégiques sur la base d’hypothèses métier, en collaboration avec les parties prenantes concernées.
Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec des collègues de différentes directions de la SNCB dans un contexte transversal à l’échelle de toute l’organisation.
Vous traduisez des modèles existants, aujourd’hui gérés localement, en solutions PySpark robustes et évolutives.
Vous automatisez le traitement des données et l’exécution des modèles via des pipelines dans Databricks.
Vous travaillez avec Python et PySpark dans un environnement Azure Databricks pour traiter les données, implémenter des modèles et réaliser des analyses.
Vous veillez à la transparence, à la reproductibilité et au respect des bonnes pratiques lors de l’implémentation des modèles.
Vous explorez les opportunités d’intégrer des sources de données et des techniques analytiques supplémentaires (telles que les données spatiales, l’IA ou des visualisations avancées) lorsqu’elles apportent une réelle valeur ajoutée aux insights stratégiques.
Vous suivez activement les évolutions IA et machine learning et réfléchissez à la manière dont elles peuvent renforcer la modélisation stratégique.


Un job fait pour vous ?


Vous avez un master, de préférence en mathématiques, statistiques, data science, sciences de l’ingénieur ou une autre discipline quantitative (ou équivalent par expérience) ET une expérience de minimum 4 ans en tant que data scientist en industrie.


ET vous disposez des compétences suivantes :


Vous êtes doté.e d’une solide connaissance de Python pour le data wrangling, l’analyse de données et la modélisation.
Vous avez de l’expérience avec PySpark et le travail avec de grands volumes de données.
Vous avez de l’expérience dans l’industrialisation d’analyses ou de modèles (par exemple la migration d’Excel vers du code de production).
Vous communiquez aisément, aussi bien en français qu’en anglais et pouvez expliquer clairement des modèles complexes et des hypothèses à des parties prenantes non techniques.
Vous avez un esprit structuré et êtes orienté.e solution et qualité.
Vous avez un intérêt pour le machine learning, les applications d’IA, les données géographiques ou outils GIS (par ex. QGIS, ArcGIS), le transport, la mobilité ou des systèmes opérationnels complexes ? Il s’agit d’atouts en plus.


Si vous avez obtenu votre diplôme à l'étranger, vous devez être en possession d'une attestation d'équivalence délivrée par la Communauté française pour pouvoir participer à la sélection.

Chaque personne est unique. Il est important pour nous que vous puissiez être vous-même. C’est ce qui rend la SNCB plus forte. C’est pourquoi nous accordons beaucoup d’importance à la diversité et à l’inclusion .

Qu'avons-nous à vous offrir ?

Choisir la SNCB, c'est choisir un environnement où vous pouvez apprendre et vous épanouir. Vous serez entouré de chouettes collègues qui vous soutiendront. En tant que Data Scientist, vous recevez un package salarial qui se compose de :


Un salaire attractif complété d'un 13e mois, d'une indemnité de frais, des chèques-repas et d'un bonus collectif et individuel.
Une partie du salaire est offerte sous forme de budget flexible. Vous pouvez opter pour la location d'un vélo, une voiture en leasing, pour le remboursement de l'épargne-pension, etc.
Une assurance hospitalisation et collective.
Un horaire flexible, un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à 33 jours de congés par an.
Un abonnement de train en Belgique, des avantages sur les lignes internationales et une indemnité vélo.
Des avantages pour votre famille comme des réductions sur les sorties en famille et dans les magasins.


Où allez-vous travailler ?

Vous travaillerez à proximité de la gare du Midi, dans le bâtiment Delta.

What’s next ?


Vous postulez en ligne et ajoutez votre lettre de motivation. Vous y décrivez brièvement votre expérience professionnelle avec PySpark : le nombre d’années d’expérience, à quel point cette expérience est récente et dans quel contexte vous l’avez utilisé. Indiquez-y également votre expérience avec Databricks ou des plateformes comparables. Finalement, racontez-nous ce qui vous attire dans ce job.
Nous analysons votre CV et lettre de motivation. Le screening est positif ? Un court entretien HR pour discuter de votre motivation, du match avec la SNCB est planifié. Nous vous posons également quelques questions techniques.
L’entretien est positif ? Vous recevez alors un exercice technique qui sera abordé pendant le 2e entretien. Pour préparer cet entretien, vous complétez un questionnaire de personnalité en ligne.
Sur la base de l’ensemble de la procédure de sélection, nous choisissions le candidat ou la candidate qui convient le mieux. Vous faites alors la connaissance du Head of Corporate strategy et du manager.
Si cette dernière rencontre est positive, vous recevez une proposition salariale.
Vous commencez votre nouveau job !


Nous nous réservons le droit d'ajuster ou de suspendre cette procédure en cas de nécessité. Notre équipe de recrutement sélectionnera les profils les plus en adéquation avec les exigences du poste afin de garantir une correspondance optimale.

Experience in working in an Agile environment.

Proficient reporting and documentation skills.
Fluency in SQL and other programming languages is highly desirable.

Career growth possibilities.

Title: CRO Specialist
Description:
Wat je gaat doen
Zie jij overal kansen om websites te verbeteren en kun je dat nog eens met data staven ook? Perfect! Als CRO Specialist bij iO maak je met jouw datagedreven optimalisaties écht impact op de conversies van websites en portalen. Jij vormt de brug tussen onze marketeers en developers en geeft hen de juiste input om mee aan de slag te gaan.

Op basis van jouw aanbevelingen uit verschillende onderzoeksmethodes, zet je proactief initiatieven op die de gebruikservaring en conversies een boost geven.

Jouw dagelijkse uitdagingen:

Van snelle audits tot diepgaande analyses: Je duikt in de data voor een brede waaier aan klanten. Je voert CRO-analyses en audits uit, brengt de pijnpunten in de customer journey bloot en vertaalt je inzichten naar concrete, impactvolle aanbevelingen.
Diepgaande optimalisatietrajecten: Je bijt je vast in complexe optimalisatieprogramma's. Hierin focus je toegewijd op het continu verbeteren van de gebruikerservaring en het maximaliseren van conversies


Dit alles doe je natuurlijk niet alleen. Je werkt nauw samen met een team van data- en analytics specialisten, UX-designers, marketeers en strategen. Je voert A/B-tests uit, analyseert de resultaten en verwerkt je bevindingen in professionele presentaties. Jouw inzichten giet je in overtuigende verhalen waarmee je zowel klanten als collega’s inspireert en aanzet tot actie.

Bij iO staan we nooit stil. We investeren volop in jouw technische kennis en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Want wij weten als geen ander: samen staan we sterker.

Daarom ben jij de perfecte CRO Specialist

Je hebt een sterk analytisch vermogen, bent van nature nieuwsgierig, werkt nauwkeurig en hebt een proactieve houding
Online personalisatietools zoals VWO, Spotler, Adobe of Blueconic hebben voor jou geen geheimen
Je bent een krak in het toepassen van CRO-principes (zoals Cialdini en andere overtuigingstechnieken) op diverse businessmodellen (B2B, B2C, e-commerce)
Met minstens 2 jaar ervaring op de teller weet jij perfect hoe je een succesvol optimalisatieplan opstelt en uitvoert
Je vindt moeiteloos je weg in tools als Clarity en Hotjar
Complexe data uit Google Looker Studio, Google Analytics en PowerBI zet jij om in overtuigende en heldere inzichten
Je hebt ervaring met HTML en CSS. Kennis van JavaScript is een dikke plus!
Je weet hoe je duidelijke en overtuigende presentaties maakt en kunt je bevindingen uitstekend onderbouwen


Dit krijg jij van ons

32 vakantiedagen
Op basis van een 40-urige werkweek heb je 20 vakantiedagen en 12 ADV-dagen.

Mobiliteit & eindejaarspremie
Na 6 maanden in dienst kun je bij iO rekenen op een eindejaarspremie. En op mobiliteitsvlak bieden we verschillende mogelijkheden, passend bij jouw job of voorkeur.

Hospitalisatieverzekering
Heb je eens iets voor? Dan is extra stress rond kosten het laatste wat je kunt gebruiken. Iedereen geniet bij ons van een hospitalisatieverzekering bij Axa.

Hybride werken
Een goede werk-privébalans is essentieel. Samen met je team maak je afspraken over wanneer én waar je werkt.

Gezonde snacks & lunch
Op elke iO campus pak je de hele dag een gezond tussendoortje en lunch je voor een kleine vergoeding gezond én gevarieerd.

Persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget
Je krijgt elk jaar € 3.000,- om jezelf te ontwikkelen, in je vak of als persoon, met trainingen, events of cursussen.

Samen vieren
Als we iets te vieren hebben, dan doen we het goed! Het partyteam op jouw campus staat op z'n tijd dan ook garant voor de leukste (thema)feestjes.

Title: Data Analyst – Cloud Migration & BigQuery
Description:
Descrizione Del Lavoro

Our organization is launching a strategic initiative to migrate its data infrastructure from an on-premise Oracle Database environment to Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The project involves consolidating legacy data warehouses, re-architecting ETL/ELT pipelines, and adopting cloud-native services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Dataflow.

The selected Data Analyst will be a key contributor across every phase of the migration lifecycle: from as-is data analysis of source systems, through post-migration validation, to supporting business teams in their transition to new cloud-based analytics tools

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Mapping


Inventory and document Oracle source data (schemas, tables, stored procedures, views)
Perform data profiling to identify anomalies, duplicates, and inconsistencies
Define logical data mappings from Oracle to BigQuery for each data domain
Collaborate with data engineers on the definition of transformation rules


Validation & Quality Assurance


Design and implement data reconciliation tests for pre- and post-migration phases
Develop SQL / BigQuery SQL queries to compare source and target datasets
Produce data quality reports covering completeness, accuracy, and consistency metrics
Log and track data anomalies using issue-tracking tools
Strong data modeling skills, including conceptual, logical, and physical design, with hands-on experience in normalization and dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schema).﻿


Migration Support ﻿


Actively participate in sprint planning and stand-ups with technical and business teams
Support the migration of legacy reports into GCP-native tools (Looker, Looker Studio)
Contribute to the definition of data governance standards and cloud best practices
Document data transformation processes for knowledge transfer purposes


Personal Profile & Soft Skills﻿


Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail
Ability to communicate complex data findings to non-technical stakeholders
Operational autonomy and a proactive approach to problem-solving
Good time management in multi-task and project-driven environments
Team player: comfortable working in cross-functional IT/Business teams
Flexibility and adaptability in contexts of technological change
Language: Italian Native or Bilingual
Language: English (written and spoken, minimum B2 level)


Education


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
Specialization courses in data engineering, cloud computing, or analytics are a plus

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Join us as our new Data Analyst / Business Intelligence

Mission Summary

The Data Analyst supports Gold Avenue's Head of Business Intelligence in keeping the company's data and reporting accurate, consistent and accessible. The role covers data quality checks, tracking maintenance, pipeline monitoring, and maintains the KPIs, dashboards and analytical models that power weekly, monthly and executive reporting. It also serves as a first point of contact for cross-team data requests, helping other departments get, understand and act on the data they need.

Your mission

Data quality & tracking support


Data quality checks: Run routine checks to catch and flag discrepancies between tools, escalating issues that need deeper fixes.
Tracking maintenance: Help maintain tracking standards and naming conventions across Mixpanel, GA4 and Google Tag Manager, keeping the tracking white book up to date.
Pipeline support: Help run and monitor the existing data transformation pipelines (SQL), with senior support on more complex changes.
BI evolution: Contribute to the ongoing Looker Studio to Tableau migration, rebuilding data connections and dashboards alongside the Head of BI.
Roadmap Contribution: Contribute quarterly to BI/data roadmap prioritisation and process/tooling improvements.
Integration Management: Support third-party data integrations, tracking and pipeline adjustments during IT system changes.


Performance Reporting & Analysis


KPI Reporting: Prepare and update the KPIs for the Weekly Business Meeting.
Dashboard maintenance: Keep existing dashboards current and accurate, and help build new views as needs arise.
(CRO) Funnel and conversion analysis. Support CVR and funnel tracking by market and segment, monitor drop-off rates, and report on A/B test results and conversion uplift
Analytical modelling support: Support and maintain the analytical models (LTV, retention cohorts, ROAS) under the guidance of the Head of BI.
Forecasting & Trend Analysis: Support Head of BI in forecast and trend analysis for planning and target-setting


Data Service Center & Cross-team Support


Data Request handling: Act as a first point of contact for cross-department data requests, resolving straightforward tickets and escalating complex ones.
Ad-hoc analysis. Assist teams with queries, attribution questions and deep-dive analyses.
Self-service enablement: Help & empower teams to read and interpret dashboards on their own through documentation and informal training, reducing ad-hoc requests over time.
Stakeholder partnership: Build strong working relationships with Marketing, CRM and Product to anticipate data needs.


Your Skills

Languages & Experience


Native-level French and English.
Bachelor degree in IT/Business/Finance or equivalent
1 to 3 years in a data or analytics role, or a strong graduate with relevant internships and project work.


Technical


Solid SQL and a working understanding of how databases and data warehouses are structured.
Some Python for data transformation and automation, or a clear willingness to grow it.
Exposure to BI tools (Tableau or Looker Studio) and an appetite to develop dashboard skills.
Basic understanding of key ecommerce performance metrics and web tracking tools.
Comfortable in Microsoft Excel and Google Suite.


Behavioral


Attention to detail, with care for data quality, consistency and clean documentation.
Curiosity about ecommerce, growth and conversion metrics, and how data drives business impact.
Clear communicator who can explain findings simply to non-technical audiences.
Proactive and willing to learn, comfortable working with guidance rather than fully alone.
Collaborative across Marketing, Product and CRM teams.


Tools


SQL, Python, Excel / Google Suite, Mixpanel, Tableau / Looker Studio, Google Analytics (GA4), Kochava, Google Tag Manager, Claude AI, Slack

Support the implementation of data governance frameworks, policies and standards.
Collaborate with data stewards, business stakeholders and technical teams to address data-related challenges.
Identify data quality gaps, recommend remediation measures and document progress.
Analyse data to uncover trends, inconsistencies and opportunities for improvement.
Prepare reports and dashboards that communicate findings clearly to stakeholders.
Coordinate initiatives including data clean-up activities, process reviews and tool rollouts.
Document data processes, workflows and good practices to improve operational efficiency.
Contribute to management reporting and identify potential data management risks.
Apply digital tools and automation techniques to enhance data governance and quality practices.
Maintain awareness of relevant technologies, external standards and industry developments.


About The Customer

Our client is a leading international financial institution committed to using data effectively, securely and responsibly. The organisation is expanding its data management capabilities, with a strong focus on improving the business value and quality of its data assets.

This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to enterprise-wide data initiatives, helping the organisation strengthen its data governance, management and quality practices. The position combines hands-on data analysis with stakeholder engagement and offers significant exposure to business and technical teams across an international environment.

Essential


Three to five years’ experience in data management, data governance, data analytics or a closely related field.
Practical knowledge of data management frameworks, master data management and data quality standards.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Business Administration or a related discipline.
Strong analytical, strategic-thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent written English, with the ability to prepare clear reports and documentation.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at different levels.
Proactive, detail-oriented and comfortable working both independently and collaboratively.


Nice to Have


Experience within financial services or another highly regulated environment.
Previous experience as a data owner, data steward or management consultant on significant data engagements.
A recognised professional certification in data governance or data management.


Compensation Benefits

Please note interviews would be conducted via video call (max two rounds), however the role is based 100% in Switzerland. Our client offers:


A role focused on delivering tangible business value through stronger data management and quality.
The opportunity to work in a diverse and international environment on a long-term basis
50% working from home
20 days working remotely from abroad per year
Modern office in central Basel (50 minutes direct train from Zurich) with subsidised canteen

Title: Business/Data Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
Ekkiden ist eine in 2019 gegründete internationale Beratungsgruppe: sie vereint ein Ökosystem leidenschaftlicher und engagierter Beraterinnen und Berater, die Transformationsprojekte in den Bereichen Organisation, Operations und Technologie durchführen, insbesondere in IT/Digital, Industrie/F&E sowie Nachhaltigkeit, für Großunternehmen und KMU in Frankreich, der Schweiz, Spanien und Deutschland.

Über die Rolle

Als Business Analyst und/oder Data Analyst übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen, Data/BI und IT. Du analysierst Prozesse und Daten, definierst Kennzahlen und Berichte und trägst so massgeblich zu datenbasierten Entscheidungen und zur Optimierung der Geschäftsabläufe bei.

Aufgaben


Aufnahme, Analyse und Strukturierung von fachlichen und datenbezogenen Anforderungen aus den Business Units
Analyse und Dokumentation von Geschäftsprozessen sowie der zugrunde liegenden Datenflüsse und Systeme.
Durchführung von Datenanalysen und Auswertungen (z. B. in Excel oder BI-Tools) zur Unterstützung von Management-Entscheidungen.
Definition von KPIs, Reports und Dashboards in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und Data/BI-Teams.
Erstellung von Fachkonzepten, Spezifikationen und User Stories für datengetriebene Lösungen (Reporting, Analytics, Automatisierung).
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit IT, Data Engineers und BI-Spezialisten bei der Umsetzung der Anforderungen in Datenmodelle und Berichte.
Kontinuierliche Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen in Prozessen, Datenqualität und Transparenz.
Strukturierte Dokumentation von fachlichen Anforderungen, Prozessen und relevanten Datenstrukturen.


Must-have


Mehrjährige Erfahrung (5+) als Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im datengetriebenen Umfeld
Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten und ein ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis.
Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Daten und Reporting (z. B. Excel, SQL-Grundlagen oder gängige BI-Tools z.B. Power BI)
Erfahrung in der Aufnahme und Dokumentation von Anforderungen (z. B. mittels Use Cases, User Stories, Fachkonzepten).
Sicheres Auftreten und starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit gegenüber fachlichen und technischen Stakeholdern.
Strukturierte, selbständige Arbeitsweise und hohe Qualitätsorientierung.
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) in Wort und Schrift, gute Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil.


Nice to have


Kenntnisse in Datenmodellierung, DWH- oder ETL-Konzepten.
Erfahrung in agilen Methoden (Scrum, Kanban) und Arbeit mit Tools wie Jira und Confluence.
Kenntnisse in Prozessmodellierung (z. B. BPMN, UML).


Wie sieht der Rekrutierungsprozess bei Ekkiden aus?

Bei Ekkiden sind wir bestrebt, jedem Kandidaten eine positive Erfahrung zu bieten.


Erstgespräch: Unser Rekrutierungsteam wird sich mit Ihnen in Verbindung setzen, um Ihre Motivation und Erwartungen zu besprechen.
Interviews: Je nach der Rolle, für die Sie sich bewerben, führen Sie ein oder zwei Interviews mit unseren Geschäftsleitern.
Kundengespräch: Schließlich haben Sie die Möglichkeit, den Kunden kennenzulernen.


Obwohl dies unser Standardprozess ist, können wir Anpassungen vornehmen, die auf spezifischen Umständen basieren.

Title: Procurement Data Manager / Analyst (EMEA) 100% (f/m/d) (Contract through our external payroll partner with immediate start until 31.12.2026, possible extension)
Description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Reporting to the Head of Procurement Data & Performance — who serves as the global data steward for procurement data and owns all relevant purchasing data — this role supports the design, management, and implementation of data standards

underpinning the new procurement platform across EMEA.

Contribute to the ramp-up of a global Source-to-Pay transformation, maintaining

alignment with regulatory and risk frameworks and working closely with stakeholders across HR, Finance, TPRM, Outsourcing, Legal, and IT.

This is a supporting role focused on designing and translating the data steward’s

standards into consistent, well-governed practices across the end-to-end lifecycle of purchasing data, including collection, enforcement, and reporting. This is not an

operational data-entry position.

YOUR CHALLENGE


Support the Head of Procurement Data & Performance in defining, managing, and implementing end-to-end standards for purchasing data collection, enforcement,
and reporting
Contribute to the definition and application of master data structures, standards, and governance within SAP S/4HANA, particularly for Business Partner records covering both suppliers and customers
Aid in data collection standardisation along supplier, engagement and commercial data aggregation

Title: Business Intelligence Developer
Description:
Business Intelligence Developer
 

Arbeiten am Puls der digitalen Transformation. Unsere Abteilung Digital Business macht's möglich. Gestalte zusammen mit uns die Zukunft der Immobilienbewirtschaftung, entwickle innovative Produkte und Prozesse und bring Livit gemeinsam mit uns voran. Im Digital Business erwartet dich ein grossartiges, interdisziplinäres Team, eine inspirierende Arbeitsatmosphäre und spannende Projekte, bei denen du dich aktiv einbringen kannst. Dich begeistern Innovationen, die neusten Systeme, ein agiles Setting und neue Herausforderungen? Dann bist du bei Livit genau richtig. Wir freuen uns auf deinen persönlichen Beitrag.
 

Zürich

100 - 100%

Deine Aufgaben

Du unterstützt unser BI-Team von der Konzeption und dem Design bis zur Entwicklung, dem Betrieb und der Weiterentwicklung unserer BI- und Reporting-Lösungen
Du spezifizierst, entwickelst und wartest Kunden-Reports in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachbereichen sowie externen Partnern
Du stellst die fach- und termingerechte Bereitstellung von elektronischen Schnittstellen und Reports für interne und externe Empfänger sicher
Du dokumentierst, wartest und optimierst bestehende sowie neu entwickelte Schnittstellen, Datenflüsse und Reporting-Lösungen
Du arbeitest im Rahmen der Ablösung unseres Immobilien-ERP-Systems aktiv an der Migration und Neuentwicklung bestehender Data-Warehouse- und Reporting-Lösungen mit
Du analysierst fachliche Anforderungen und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen im Bereich Data Warehouse und Reporting
Du trägst mit Deiner Expertise zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Business-Intelligence-Services bei

 

Dein Profil

Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Berufsbildung als Informatiker:in EFZ oder über eine entsprechende höhere Ausbildung (HF, FH oder Universität) mit Schwerpunkt Informatik
Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Datenbankentwicklung mit MS SQL Server mit und verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in den Technologien SSRS, SSIS sowie in der Entwicklung von Stored Procedures
Du besitzt idealerweise Kenntnisse in PostgreSQL und bringst Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit unterschiedlichen Datenbanksystemen mit
Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Entwicklungstools wie SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), DBeaver, RedGate Toolbelt, Visual Studio sowie Confluence und JIRA
Du hast von Vorteil bereits Erfahrungen in der Immobilienbranche gesammelt, insbesondere in der Bewirtschaftung oder Liegenschaftsbuchhaltung
Du kennst idealerweise die Immobiliensoftware G-REM von GARAIO REM
Du kommunizierst stilsicher in Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Du zeichnest dich durch eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus
Du übernimmst Verantwortung, bringst Eigeninitiative ein und arbeitest gerne in einem dynamischen Umfeld mit vielfältigen Anspruchsgruppen

 

Benefits

Internes Angebot unserer Livit Akademie für Fach- und Führungskurse
Finanzielle und/oder zeitliche Unterstützung bei externen Fachausbildungen sowie Zugang zu elektronischen Lernplattformen für online Sprachkursen
individuelle Karriereplanung und Entwicklungsperspektiven
Home- / Mobile Office
Bonus in Abhängigkeit des Unternehmenserfolgs und der persönlichen Leistung
Mindestens 5 Wochen Ferien und Kauf von bis zu 10 zusätzlichen Tagen Ferien (Ferienflex)
Überdurchschnittliche Vorsorgeleistungen und Prämien für Krankentaggeld- und Unfallversicherung werden zu 100% von Livit übernommen
14 Tage Vaterschaftsurlaub

Livit Family

Wir lieben Immobilien und setzen uns mit Begeisterung für die Werterhaltung der Liegenschaften unserer Kunden ein.

Wenn du bei Livit arbeitest, gehörst du zur Livit Family. Du wirst geschätzt für das, was du bist und was du tust. Denn nicht nur deine Skills und deine Erfahrung, sondern auch du als Mensch bist uns wichtig. In unserem Arbeitsumfeld fühlst du dich wohl und kannst dich entfalten. Das liegt einerseits an unseren vielseitigen Jobprofilen und den Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb unseres Unternehmens. Andererseits aber auch an der unverwechselbaren Unternehmenskultur, die in der Immobilienwelt ihresgleichen sucht.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Le cabinet Sigma Suisse, basé à Plan-les-Ouates, est un cabinet de recrutement spécialisé dans le recrutement de profils informatique et stratégiques accompagnant des acteurs influent en Suisse romande.




Au sein du département IT, nous intervenons sur des besoins relatifs aux secteurs du Trading de matières premières ou financiers, Pharmaceutique, Aéronautique, Spatial, Énergie, Horlogerie et des fondations Suisse.




Nous recrutons un(e) BI / Data Engineer pour un groupe agro-industriel international, poste fixe basé à Fribourg, sur site.




Le contexte, un écosystème BI (Data Warehouse, SSRS, Tableau) au coeur du pilotage d'un siège et de filiales multi-pays. Votre rôle, reprendre et développer l'opérationnel BI, faire évoluer le Data Warehouse et accompagner les projets Data transverses.




Ce que vous ferez :




Concevoir, développer et maintenir les rapports et tableaux de bord du catalogue BI Groupe sous SSRS et Tableau
Garantir la fiabilité, la performance et la disponibilité des rapports en production
Prioriser et traiter les demandes évolutives et correctives remontées par les métiers et les filiales
Assurer le support BI aux utilisateurs du siège et des filiales, gérer les accès et le suivi des tickets
Accompagner la montée en autonomie des Business Owners et des utilisateurs clés
Faire évoluer le Data Warehouse, schémas, tables, vues et data marts, au service des besoins métiers
Développer et maintenir les flux d'alimentation ETL / SSIS depuis les applications sources (ERP, RH, agro)
Veiller à la qualité, la cohérence et l'exploitabilité des données
Contribuer aux chantiers Data transverses, référentiel Agro, reporting industriel, SEI, IBM PA, ArcGIS
Travailler en lien avec les équipes dev / applications, infrastructure et cybersécurité




Le profil :




3 ans minimum en BI / Data Engineering
Solide maîtrise SQL et SQL Server
Expérience Data Warehouse et notions ETL (SSIS)
Connaissance ERP
Français langue maternelle, anglais C1




Un plus selon votre appétence, DBA SQL Server, IBM Planning Analytics (TM1), Architecture Data / MDM ou Power BI.

Title: Business Intelligence Engineer (M/F)- Geneva
Description:
Main responsibilities:

As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you will support business units in analysing their reporting and data utilisation needs in order to aid decision-making. You will design, develop and maintain dashboards and Business Intelligence solutions, whilst contributing to the continuous improvement of the company’s data strategy.




You will be part of a dynamic and expert team, where you will be encouraged to put forward innovative ideas, develop new concepts and play an active role in strategic projects.




Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI.

Gather, analyse and translate business requirements into relevant reporting solutions.

Recommend improvements to optimise Business Intelligence processes and tools.

Help define the product vision and data strategy.

Monitor, control and troubleshoot daily data processing operations.

Support strategic projects in your capacity as a Business Intelligence specialist.

Ensure the quality, consistency and reliability of the data made available to users.

Draft and maintain technical and functional documentation for BI processes.

Collaborate with business and technical teams to ensure that solutions meet users’ needs.




Education:

Higher education qualification (university or university of applied sciences) in:

Computer Science, Engineering, Data & Analytics, or an equivalent field.




Experience:

At least 5 years’ experience in Business Intelligence.

Proficiency in Microsoft BI technologies:

SQL Server (T-SQL)

SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)

SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS)

SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)

Power BI




A good understanding of decision-making architectures, data flows and analytical models is required.




Soft skills:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently and a sense of responsibility.

Initiative and a focus on continuous improvement.

Ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with both business and technical stakeholders.

Team spirit and a focus on internal customers.




Languages:

Fluent English & Portuguese(essential).

Fluency in French or German is an asset, depending on the company’s context.




Technical environment:

Microsoft Power BI

Microsoft SQL Server

T-SQL

SSIS

SSAS

SSRS

Data Warehouse / Business Intelligence environment

Title: Bi / Data Engineer H/F
Description:
Le cabinet Sigma Suisse, basé à Plan-les-Ouates, est un cabinet de recrutement spécialisé dans le recrutement de profils informatique et stratégiques accompagnant des acteurs influent en Suisse romande.




Au sein du département IT, nous intervenons sur des besoins relatifs aux secteurs du Trading de matières premières ou financiers, Pharmaceutique, Aéronautique, Spatial, Énergie, Horlogerie et des fondations Suisse.




Nous recrutons un(e) BI / Data Engineer pour un groupe agro-industriel international, poste fixe basé à Fribourg, sur site.

Le contexte, un écosystème BI (Data Warehouse, SSRS, Tableau) au coeur du pilotage d'un siège et de filiales multi-pays. Votre rôle, reprendre et développer l'opérationnel BI, faire évoluer le Data Warehouse et accompagner les projets Data transverses.

Ce que vous ferez :

Concevoir, développer et maintenir les rapports et tableaux de bord du catalogue BI Groupe sous SSRS et Tableau
Garantir la fiabilité, la performance et la disponibilité des rapports en production
Prioriser et traiter les demandes évolutives et correctives remontées par les métiers et les filiales
Assurer le support BI aux utilisateurs du siège et des filiales, gérer les accès et le suivi des tickets
Accompagner la montée en autonomie des Business Owners et des utilisateurs clés
Faire évoluer le Data Warehouse, schémas, tables, vues et data marts, au service des besoins métiers
Développer et maintenir les flux d'alimentation ETL / SSIS depuis les applications sources (ERP, RH, agro)
Veiller à la qualité, la cohérence et l'exploitabilité des données
Contribuer aux chantiers Data transverses, référentiel Agro, reporting industriel, SEI, IBM PA, ArcGIS
Travailler en lien avec les équipes dev / applications, infrastructure et cybersécurité

Le profil :

3 ans minimum en BI / Data Engineering
Solide maîtrise SQL et SQL Server
Expérience Data Warehouse et notions ETL (SSIS)
Connaissance ERP
Français langue maternelle, anglais C1

Un plus selon votre appétence, DBA SQL Server, IBM Planning Analytics (TM1), Architecture Data / MDM ou Power BI.

En tant que Power BI & Microsoft Fabric Expert chez Ivy Partners, vous serez amené(e) à :

- Réaliser des modèles sémantiques et des dashboards dans Power BI.

- Former et aider les data analysts au quotidien afin de les rendre autonomes dans la réalisation de dashboards complexes sur Power BI.

- Collecter, préparer, nettoyer et structurer les données issues de différentes sources internes et externes.

- Construire et maintenir des modèles de données robustes et optimisés (Snowflake, Datamarts Power BI).

- Assurer la qualité, la cohérence et la gouvernance des données (validation, règles métier, dictionnaire de données).

- Concevoir et développer des rapports, tableaux de bord et visualisations interactives sous Power BI.

- Maîtriser et écrire des scripts DAX avancés (mesures complexes, optimisation de performance, calculs dynamiques).

- Gérer la publication et la sécurité dans l’environnement Power BI Service (workspaces, RLS/OLS, refresh scheduling).

- Optimiser les performances des rapports et des datasets (meilleures pratiques, monitoring, capacity planning).

- Former et coacher les utilisateurs internes sur Power BI.

- Participer à l’évolution de l’architecture BI et aux initiatives de modernisation (data lake, automatisation, gouvernance).

Bienveillance | Soucieux de nos employés, nous leur garantissons un environnement favorable où chacun est valorisé et soutenu avec des formations et de réelles perspectives d’évolution.

Title: EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst
Description:
Our Company

JOB DESCRIPTION

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

EFG is committed to providing an equitable and inclusive working environment that is founded on the principle of mutual respect. Joining our team means experiencing a supportive environment, where your contributions are valued and recognised. We strongly believe that the diversity of our teams gives us a competitive advantage by fostering better decision-making and greater innovation.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

We are a private bank, offering personalised solutions on a global scale to private and institutional clients. Our sustainable success is based on our talents and on how we partner with our clients and communities to create lasting value.

Job Description

The EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst will be part of the Group Performance Measurement, Budgeting & Reporting Team in Lugano and will contribute to develop and run an integrated planning, reporting and performance review process to facilitate value-driven business decision-making. In his role as EPM OneStream Developer, the resource will oversee running, maintenance and development of our existing OneStream planning platform. In his role as EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst, the resource will support the performance measurement activities by running granular analysis of financial performance root causes and by providing insights on value creation levers.

The resource will play an active role supporting business development and providing value-added decision support using data modelling and forecasting intelligence.

Main Responsibilities


EPM OneStream Developer
Business analyst and power user of MI data
Design and maintain data models for analysis and forecasting
Establish and compile dashboards and presentations to senior management
Take active role in the business performance dialogues
Active collaboration with Strategy & Corporate Development unit during budgeting and forecasting process
Design and develop MI reports and simulations with data from the various MIS systems of the bank to provide insight on value creation levers to the business
Develop strong relationship with business management and business controllers to support the Planning & Controlling business partnership


Skills And Experience


Professional experience in EPM Business Intelligence in Financial Industry
OneStream software: EPM applications maintenance and developments expert
Ability to understand large datasets and experience of data modelling, providing accurate data analysis
Power user of OneStream, MS-PowerBI, MS-Excel and PowerPoint; Knowledge of Excel Macros, VBA, Python, SAS Enterprise Guide to automate data extraction and reporting
Quick learner, accurate and efficient
Proactive attitude and willingness to take on new knowledge and skills
Ability to work under pressure and adapt to unforeseen work demands
Good communication skills to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels
Fluent in Italian and English


Our Values


Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement
Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results
Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence
Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset
Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Title: Data Governance Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
Key role in building the data governance capabilities
Long-term project with strong visibility and stakeholder exposure


About Our Client

Our client, a leading international financial institution based in Basel, is expanding its newly established Data Office and is seeking a Data Governance Analyst (m/f/d) for an immediate start.

This is an initial 2-year contract with the possibility of extension and potential conversion to a permanent position, subject to business requirements and performance.

Job Description

The selected candidate helps drive enterprise-wide data governance, data quality and data management initiatives, partnering with business and technology stakeholders to maximise the value of data across the organisation through the following key responsibilities:


Collaborates with data stewards, business stakeholders and technical teams to address data-related challenges and support solution implementation
Supports the development and adoption of data governance frameworks, policies and standards aligned with organisational objectives
Contributes to data quality initiatives by identifying gaps, recommending improvements and tracking remediation efforts
Performs data analysis to identify trends, inconsistencies and improvement opportunities, and prepares reports and dashboards for stakeholders
Coordinates data-related initiatives, including data cleansing activities, process enhancements and tool implementations
Maintains and updates documentation of data processes, workflows and best practices.
Supports the preparation of management reporting and data-driven insights
Identifies data management risks and recommends appropriate mitigation measures
Utilises digital tools and automation to improve data governance, management and quality practices
Keeps abreast of emerging technologies, industry standards and best practices in data management and governance


The Successful Applicant

In order to be considered for the role, the ideal candidate must have:


Successfully completed bachelor's or master's degree in information management, computer science or a related field
Professional certification in data governance or data management (eg CMDB) preferred
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in Data Governance, Data Management, Data Quality, Data Analytics, or a similar field, ideally within Financial Services or another highly regulated environment
Practical experience working as a Data Steward, Data Owner, Data Governance professional, or on data-focused consulting engagements
Solid understanding of Data Governance frameworks, Data Quality principles, and Data Management best practices
Very good writing skills in English
Excellent analytical, strategic thinking and problem-solving skills
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders across the organisation at all levels

Title: Risk & Compliance Analytics Engineer
Description:
Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 900 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units and include the Communications, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Strategy & Projects, and Tax departments.

You will join the Risk & Compliance Data Office, which aims to be the trusted and innovative data partner for the Group’s Risk & Compliance community. The unit empowers informed decision making and proactive risk management through cutting edge technology, scalable platforms and high-quality data. Its mission is to deliver reliable, well-governed and forward-looking data solutions that meet evolving regulatory requirements, foster data driven insights and enable confident, strategic decision making.

This position will initially focus more strongly on data engineering, supporting the evolution of Risk & Compliance data platforms and the migration of data and analytics capabilities to Snowflake. As with all Analytics Engineers, the role is expected to evolve over time in response to business needs and team priorities.

Your role


Working with risk managers, compliance officers and executive leadership to translate strategic goals and regulatory requirements into robust, high-quality data products, including analytics, dashboards and reporting solutions.
Acting as a trusted data advisor to stakeholders, providing guidance and support to ensure effective use of analytics and reporting, while translating ambiguous business requirements into clear, actionable technical specifications.
Taking end-to-end ownership of business themes by proactively driving initiatives that align data solutions with business needs and deliver measurable value, from data source to executive insight.
Developing the architecture and managing the end-to-end value chain for risk and compliance data verticals, ensuring that the resulting analytics and reports can be used across the Group.
Designing and rolling out precise, executive-ready metrics and interactive dashboards that stand up to regulatory scrutiny and support the Group’s strategic risk posture.
Driving the modernisation and streamlining of legacy business logic by migrating and automating solutions into modern data architectures and cloud platforms, as well as implementing innovative approaches, such as AI, intelligent agents and automation, to enhance analytics capabilities.
Ensuring rigorous data quality and controls in line with the Group's data governance framework in order to maintain the integrity of mission-critical risk and compliance data.
Managing high-volume, time-sensitive ad hoc requests and complex regulatory reports autonomously and resiliently.
Proactively engaging with stakeholders to anticipate their needs, identifying opportunities for data-driven improvements and championing best practices in analytics and reporting.
Contributing to cross-functional initiatives to align the Risk & Compliance community and the Group on data governance, data strategy, data literacy and best practices.


Your profile


A master’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Engineering or a related field. Advanced certifications (e.g. FRM or CFA) would be a plus.
At least five years’ experience in a high impact data role, such as Data Engineering, Data Analytics or AI/ML, including hands-on expertise.
Expert-level proficiency in SQL and Python, including the design, maintenance and orchestration of modern ETL/ELT workflows.
Experience with Snowflake and modern cloud-based data platforms would be a strong asset.
Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms such as Tableau, Power BI or equivalent.
Knowledge of risk management, compliance, banking operations and/or regulatory reporting would be an advantage.
Entrepreneurial and “can‑do” attitude, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast‑paced matrix environment.
Strong communication, problem solving, organisational, interpersonal and project management skills.
Excellent command of French and English, both written and spoken.
Must be resident in Switzerland, or willing to relocate.


Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Ref.: R&CAE/MH/JC

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Konzeption und Entwicklung von Datenmodellen auf Basis von SAP Datasphere

Umsetzung, Dokumentation und Einführung der entwickelten Datenmodelle
Steuerung datengetriebener Projekte und Initiativen als Projekt- oder Programmmanager:in
Aufbau und Einführung eines Process-Mining-Tools für Root-Cause-Analysen

Sie haben abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
Sie begeistern sich für Daten, Analysen und Prozesse und besitzen ein ausgeprägtes konzeptionelles Denkvermögen

Sie fühlen sich sicher im Umgang mit großen Datenmengen und haben Erfahrung mit Datenbanken sowie Datenvisualisierungstools
Sie besitzen gute bis sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL sowie Erfahrung mit SAP; Kenntnisse in Python sind von Vorteil
Sie sind in der Lage die Erkenntnisse Ihrer Arbeit verständlich, adressatengerecht und überzeugend gegenüber den Stakeholdern zu kommunizieren

Job Description

Location: Zurich

Du analysierst und verstehst kundenspezifische Lösungen von der Datenintegration, Datentransformation bis hin zu Analytics - mit dem Ziel das Datenmanagement unter Einsatz von State- of - the -Art Technologien nachhaltig zu verbessern.

Für diese Position bieten wir derzeit Starttermine ab September 202 6 an.

Dein Impact


Entwurf und Implementierung moderner Datenlösungen im Bereich Datenmanagement (z. B. Datenqualität, Stamm- und Referenzdaten, Datenkataloge und Datenplattformen), um qualitativ hochwertige und verwertbare Daten bereitzustellen.
Entwicklung von Datenstrategien, die unseren Kunden dabei helfen, ihre Geschäftsziele in den Bereichen Compliance, Kostensenkung und Umsatzsteigerung zu erreichen.
Konzeption komplexer Daten- und Analytik-Transformationen durch die Bereitstellung architektonischer, technischer und organisatorischer Grundlagen sowie Beratung der Kunden bei der Durchführung dieser Transformationen, die erhebliche Auswirkungen auf die Organisation haben .

Vorbildfunktion durch hohe Arbeitsmoral, ausgeprägte Führungsqualitäten und fachliche Kompetenz.
Weiterentwicklung deiner Kompetenzen in verschiedenen Branchen und Fachgebieten sowie Weitergabe deines Wissens an Kolleginnen und Kollegen.



Wen wir suchen

Antrieb und Motivation


Leidenschaftliche Persönlichkeiten, die eine Karriere in der Beratung mit Schwerpunkt Data Engineering aufbauen möchten .
Ausgeprägte Lernbereitschaft, Offenheit für neue Themen und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben selbstständig in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu steuern .



Beratungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten


Starke Schreib- und Microsoft PowerPoint-Fähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, aussagekräftige Präsentationen zu gestalten .
Starke konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Anforderungen zu einem stimmigen Lösungsdesign zusammenzuführen und komplexe Probleme zu vereinfachen .

Liebe zum Detail und Fähigkeit, technische Spezifikationen klar in schriftlicher und mündlicher Form zu kommunizieren .



Technische Expertise


Praktische Erfahrung mit Datenmanagement, Datenplattformen oder Data Engineering-Lösungen ist dringend empfohlen .
Fundierte Kenntnisse in SQL und Python sind erforderlich .
Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen wie AWS, Azure oder GCP, einschließlich der Arbeit mit Data Warehouses , ETL-Tools und modernen Data Stack-Technologien ist erforderlich .
Kenntnisse von Datenplattform-Tools (z.B. Snowflake, Databricks , Apache Spark, Airflow ) und Datenvisualisierungstools (z.B. PowerBI , Tableau) sind erforderlich .
Praktische Erfahrung mit ETL/ELT-Pipelines und Data Orchestration (z.B. Apache Airflow , Prefect , dbt ) ist erforderlich .
Verständnis von Data Warehouse- und Data Lake-Architekturen sowie deren Unterschiede und Anwendungsfälle .
Kenntnisse von Datenmodellierung und Optimierungstechniken .
Starker Ingenieur- oder Mathematik-Hintergrund ist vorteilhaft .



Sprachkompetenz


Fließend in Englisch , Deutsch und/oder Französisch ist sehr erwünscht, um die Kommunikation mit verschiedenen Teams und Stakeholdern zu erleichtern .

Erste relevante Erfahrung in Beratung, Technologieunternehmen oder branchenspezifischen Rollen, insbesondere in datengestützten Bereichen .
Frühere Erfahrung im Banking-, Versicherungs-, Life Science- oder Healthcare -Sektor ist vorteilhaft .

Description:
Nous ouvrons un poste de Business Analyst Data (H/F) afin de renforcer l'équipe de notre client basée à Lausanne, pour le domaine Industriel (Supply, Manufacturing). Ce recrutement s'inscrit dans le cadre d'un programme de transformation du système décisionnel, au sein du Data Office.




Responsabilites du poste

Recueillir, analyser et prioriser les besoins métiers liés au reporting, à l’analyse de données et au pilotage de la performance.
Animer des ateliers avec les parties prenantes afin de définir les indicateurs, les processus métiers et les règles de gestion.
Étudier les processus existants pour identifier des opportunités d’amélioration, d’optimisation et de standardisation des usages de la donnée.
Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles et contribuer à la définition des KPI, des dimensions analytiques et des règles métier nécessaires aux solutions décisionnelles.
Collaborer avec les équipes Data (Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers et experts métiers) à la conception des modèles de données et des modèles sémantiques de la plateforme BI.
Accompagner les phases de développement, de tests et de validation en veillant à l’adéquation entre les solutions livrées et les besoins fonctionnels.
Participer aux activités de gouvernance des données, notamment en contribuant à la documentation, aux référentiels et aux standards de qualité.
Favoriser l’adoption des solutions analytiques auprès des utilisateurs et maintenir une documentation fonctionnelle claire et pérenne.




Prérequis du poste

Expérience confirmée de 8 à 10 ans en Business Intelligence, Data Analytics ou analyse fonctionnelle.
Excellente capacité à comprendre les besoins métiers et à les transformer en exigences fonctionnelles structurées.
Bonne maîtrise des principes de modélisation décisionnelle (schéma en étoile, dimensions, faits, KPI, modèles sémantiques).
Au moins 5 ans d’expérience sur des projets Supply Chain, Manufacturing ou équivalents.
Expérience avec des plateformes analytiques modernes telles que Power BI, Databricks, dbt ou des environnements Data Cloud.
Capacité à collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires dans un contexte de transformation Data.
Une expérience dans le secteur de l’horlogerie constitue un atout.
