Title: Equipment Management Database Specialist (EP-CMS-SSI-2026-166-LD)
Description:
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, physicists and engineers are probing the fundamental structure of the universe. Using the world's largest and most complex scientific instruments, they study the basic constituents of matter - fundamental particles that are made to collide together at close to the speed of light. The process gives physicists clues about how particles interact, and provides insights into the fundamental laws of nature.





Job Description



Introduction



The role is responsible for ensuring that all equipment installed or removed during CMS Long Shutdown 3 (LS3) is accurately recorded in the CMS Equipment Management Database (EMdb). Acting as the interface between the physical inventory and the database, the post-holder ensures data consistency, maintains and enhances the database and its associated applications, and develops tools to improve data visualisation and accessibility. The role combines strong IT expertise with an understanding of the CMS experiment's equipment and asset management processes. It also provides support to colleagues across the CMS experiment in keeping the database up to date by preparing dedicated documentation and labelling for the services installation campaign, ensuring that equipment can be accurately identified, tracked and managed throughout its lifecycle.



Functions



Ensure the consistency, accuracy and integrity of the CMS Equipment Management Database by synchronising it with the physical installation and decommissioning of equipment.
Act as the interface between field inventory activities of CMS teams and the Equipment Management Database, ensuring that all equipment installations, removals and modifications are accurately reflected in the system.
Maintain, support and enhance the Equipment Management Database and its applications, ensuring their reliability and long-term sustainability while developing new features, dashboards and visualisation tools for equipment traceability, data quality monitoring and reporting.
Drive continuous improvements to the usability, functionality and efficiency of the Equipment Management Database by streamlining the registration and management of equipment, cables and other assets, and enhancing data management and asset traceability across the CMS experiment.
Supporting work on the field, to ensure that the operational aspects of asset installation run smoothly for the CMS experiment and that there is coherence between installed equipment and services and the database inventory
Collaborate with the CERN Enterprise Asset Management service and ensure the inter-operationality of processes within the CERN-wide infrastructure and applications.


Qualifications



Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Computer Science or Applied Physics or a related field.







Experience:



Experience with relational databases and SQL.
Experience with web application development, using for example Oracle APEX, PHP, JavaScript, client-oriented APIs.
Experience monitoring data quality and ensuring data consistency between physical assets and the digital inventory system.
Experience with engineering equipment, scientific infrastructure, or large-scale technical installations.
Ability to develop dashboards and application features.
Proactive in improving processes and application functionality.
Familiarity with the CMS Experimental and upgrade program is an advantage.
Ability to bridge operational activities in the field with IT systems and interface CERN asset management procedures.

Technical competencies:



Knowledge of database and/or data mining architectures and technologies.
Conceptualising, designing and developing user experiences and interfaces.
Decommissioning and disposal of detector components and systems.
Development of application software.

Behavioural competencies:



Achieving Results: defining clear objectives, milestones and deliverables before initiating work/ project.
Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.
Communicating Effectively: ensuring that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
Solving Problems: addressing complex problems by breaking them down into manageable components.
Learning and Sharing Knowledge: proposing ways to improve or streamline existing procedures, processes and methodologies.

Language skills:



Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.





Additional Information



Eligibility and closing date:



Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States.



This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 31.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.



Employment Conditions



Contract type: Limited duration contract (4 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.



Working Hours: 40 hours per week



Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite



This position involves:



Work in Radiation Areas.
Interventions in underground installations.
A valid driving licence.
Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

Job grade: 6-7



Job reference: EP-CMS-SSI-2026-166-LD



Field of work: Data Science & Data Analytics



Benchmark Job Title: Applied Physicist



Global Benefits



A competitive salary (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.
30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.



Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

Title: Reference Data Specialist
Description:
Company Description

Vitol is an energy and commodities company with revenues of $331 billion in 2024; its primary business is the trading and distribution of energy products globally – it trades over seven million barrels per day of crude oil and products and, at any time, has 250 ships transporting its cargoes.

Vitol’s clients include national oil companies, multinationals, leading industrial companies and utilities. Founded in Rotterdam in 1966, today Vitol serves clients from some 40 offices worldwide and is invested in energy assets globally including 24mM3 of storage, 850kbpd of refining capacity, and 10,000 service stations. To date, we have committed over $2.5 billion of capital to renewable projects and are identifying and developing low-carbon opportunities around the world.

Job Description

The Reference Data Specialist will manage Vitol’s reference data across multiple systems, ensuring datasets are accurate, consistent and fit for use across applications and business processes.

Role responsibilities will span three adjacent areas:


Supporting system migrations and dataset harmonisation
Provide cross-application mappings to unify datasets and manage application-specific edge cases.
Clean, validate and prepare datasets before Master Data onboarding.
Map data lineage and perform non-regression checks to protect existing application functionality.
Design and run automated tests to support application onboarding and migration activities.
Ensuring reference data quality through monitoring and review
Own Master Data-hosted reference datasets and resolve day-to-day support tickets promptly.
Define validation rules and data quality controls across key datasets.
Implement monitoring tools, exception reports and corrective actions.
Identify recurring data issues and propose improvements to prevent reoccurrence.
Acting as the first point of contact for users and application owners
Serve as a trusted partner for users, application owners and project teams on reference data matters.
Triage and resolve support requests, clarifying requirements and coordinating fixes where needed.
Support teams deploying Master Data into new or existing solutions.
Provide guidance on data consumption, mappings and onboarding standards.


Qualifications


2+ years’ experience working with C# and related .NET technologies, preferably ASP.NET Core.
Demonstrated ownership and responsiveness in a fast-paced environment.
Proven experience in data management, with strong attention to detail.
Ability to understand interlinked dependencies across systems and datasets.
Ability to audit codebases including SQL, .NET, React and Python.
Ability to develop and run non-regression and monitoring scripts in Python.
Experience with CTRM systems and commodity trading workflows is a plus but not required.


Additional Information

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to work across both business and technology teams. The candidate should be comfortable investigating data issues, understanding dependencies across systems, and translating business requirements into practical data management solutions.

Relevant experience may include:


Reference data, master data or data governance experience.
Experience supporting system migrations, application onboarding or data integration projects.
Strong understanding of data quality principles and control frameworks.
Ability to analyse datasets, identify inconsistencies and define remediation actions.
Experience working with ticketing systems and production support processes.
Familiarity with data mapping, lineage documentation and automated testing.
Strong communication skills and the ability to engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proactive, structured and detail-oriented approach to problem solving.

Bei Pax hast du nicht einfach einen Job. Es erwarten dich Aufgaben, Herausforderungen und Leistungsgebiete. Diese geben dir die Chance zur Entfaltung. Für deinen Einsatz wirst du nicht nur bezahlt, sondern auch respektiert und geschätzt.

Unsere Vision ist, für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden die beste Vorsorgeversicherung zu werden. Das erreichen wir, indem wir Vorsorge einfach gestalten. Deshalb arbeiten bei uns Persönlichkeiten, die viel bewegen und gemeinsame Ziele erreichen wollen.
 

80-100%

Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer datengetriebenen Organisation unter Einbringung eigener Ideen

Integration von Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen und Entwicklung zuverlässiger Datenpipelines

Optimierung bestehender Geschäftsprozesse in Bezug auf Performance, Stabilität und Datenqualität
Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Systemlandschaft in Richtung moderner Cloud-Architektur

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen sowie Unterstützung bei datenbasierten Entscheidungen

Kenntnisse in relevanten Technologien (Databricks, Spark, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SQL oder Python)

Title: Senior Regulatory Data Analyst
Description:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with passion and creativity, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Every day, your talent, your innovative spirit, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

As Senior Regulatory Data Analyst (reporting to the Registration & Compliance Lead, Regulatory Ingredients Compliance Strategy CoE), you will work within our Regulatory Ingredients Compliance Strategy CoE – Registration & compliance, you will provide subject matter expertise with chemical regulatory compliance, chemical management and be responsible for by carrying out compliance monitoring reviews to ensure the business is meeting its regulatory obligations and risks are mitigated.

In this role, you will develop, implement and maintain processes, programs to ensure compliance with existing and emerging chemical control legislations.

Sounds interesting? It could well be your perfect opportunity if, like us, you always aim to exceed customer needs, deliver value and are skilled at fostering strong relationships.

In This Exciting Role You Will


Perform compliance monitoring on all aspects of the CCL (Chemical Control Legislation) to assess compliance with applicable regulations, standards and outcomes.
Collaborate with the RAPS team and business stakeholders to finalise reports for presentation and submission to relevant boards and sub-committees, in line with the requirements of the plan, including impact analysis for decision making.
Provide analyses for large datasets necessary for decisions using actionable insights
Attending sub-committee’s sessions as required to present monitoring findings and recommendations.
Support the review/update/development of the regulatory/compliance policies and procedures to ensure they remain appropriate, relevant and effective.
Participate to the development of the solutions to ensure of the compliance globally, the testing and the training of the teams as needed
Define and deliver metrics, reporting platforms, dashboards for tracking and managing the compliance
Tracking of monitoring actions through to successful resolution
Identify business challenges and initiate process improvement projects
Facilitate the computerization of analytics and data collection processes


You?

Are you someone who wants to grow and shape your own world? Who thrives being in a culture where you can express yourself in a creative team environment? Who wants to collaborate and learn together with teams who are as passionate as you are? Then come join us – and impact your world.

Your Professional Profile Includes


University / Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a scientific field
A minimum of 5 years relevant in a compliance role in chemical or related industry
Proficient knowledge of BI, SAP, or other business Intelligence tools. Must also demonstrate advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
Familiarity with programming languages (e.g: Python, Javascript, SQL) and AI is a plus
Strong analytical skills
Good working knowledge of CCL regulatory requirements and legal guidelines is an advantage
Business fluency in English AND French is a must
Experience in supporting cross functional groups and teams
Ability to work well in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment


Our Benefits


Healthcare support
Paid Time Off and family leave
Retirement plan
Sport and leisure clubs
Company shop
Staff restaurant
Corporate Mobility Plan

Title: Master Data Steward
Description:
Êtes-vous prêt(e) à libérer votre potentiel ?

Chez Straumann Group, nous vivons une période passionnante de croissance, d’innovation et d’impact, guidée par notre mission d’améliorer la santé bucco-dentaire et de transformer la vie de millions de personnes dans le monde. Unis par une même raison d’être, nous donnons chaque jour le meilleur de nous-mêmes dans une culture de performance et d’apprentissage qui favorise la collaboration, la curiosité et l’ambition. Ici, vous aurez l’opportunité de prendre en main votre parcours professionnel, en développant continuellement vos compétences, votre passion et votre envie d’apprendre. Ensemble, nous ne façonnons pas seulement de plus beaux sourires : nous révélons le potentiel de chacun, y compris le vôtre.

Introduction

Dans ce rôle clé, vous contribuez à la fiabilité et à la qualité des données de référence qui soutiennent les opérations industrielles de Straumann. En tant que Master Data Steward, vous garantissez la cohérence, la conformité et la traçabilité des données tout au long de leur cycle de vie au sein de SAP, MES, PLM et des systèmes associés.

Vous travaillez au cœur des interactions entre la Production, l’Industrialisation, les Méthodes, la Qualité, la Supply Chain, le Contrôle de gestion et l’Informatique afin de garantir que les données reflètent fidèlement les processus métiers et les exigences réglementaires. Votre contribution participe directement à l’efficacité opérationnelle, à la qualité des produits et à l’amélioration continue dans un environnement industriel réglementé.

Votre rôle

Gestion des Master Data


Créer, maintenir et faire évoluer les données de référence dans SAP et les systèmes associés (articles, nomenclatures, gammes, postes de travail, données MES, PLM, informations achats et données de planification).
Garantir l’exactitude, l’intégrité, la cohérence et la conformité des données tout au long du cycle de vie des produits.
Collaborer avec les équipes métiers afin de traduire les besoins opérationnels en données fiables et exploitables.
Identifier les écarts ou anomalies, analyser leurs causes et coordonner les actions correctives.
Participer aux projets de modification de produits, procédés ou équipements en évaluant les impacts sur les données de référence.
Accompagner les activités de phase-out et assurer une désactivation cohérente et traçable des données.
Fournir un support aux utilisateurs sur les processus et règles de gestion liés aux Master Data.


Gouvernance et amélioration continue


Développer et maintenir les procédures, modes opératoires et workflows associés aux données de référence.
Contribuer à la standardisation et à l’optimisation des pratiques de gestion des données.
Participer à la modélisation et à l’amélioration des processus métier.
Soutenir les initiatives de gouvernance des données et les évolutions de systèmes.
Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques de qualité des données auprès des parties prenantes.


Analyse de données et reporting


Réaliser des analyses permettant d’évaluer la qualité des référentiels et d’identifier des opportunités d’amélioration.
Développer et suivre des indicateurs liés aux Master Data.
Contribuer à la création et à l’évolution de tableaux de bord Power BI.
Collaborer avec les équipes Data, IT et métiers pour structurer et valoriser les données.
Participer à la définition des besoins métiers liés aux outils, workflows et reportings.


Votre profil

Exigences essentielles


Formation en informatique, systèmes d’information, informatique de gestion, data ou domaine équivalent.
Expérience en gestion des Master Data dans un environnement industriel structuré.
Bonne connaissance de SAP et des données de production telles que les articles, nomenclatures, gammes de fabrication ou postes de travail.
Compréhension des exigences de qualité, de conformité, de traçabilité et de gouvernance des données.
Expérience en analyse de données et reporting.
Maîtrise avancée d’Excel et bonnes connaissances de Power BI, SQL et DAX.
Capacité à documenter des processus, rédiger des procédures et formaliser des règles de gestion.
Excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration avec des interlocuteurs variés.


Atouts appréciés


Expérience dans le secteur des dispositifs médicaux ou dans un environnement réglementé.
Connaissance de systèmes MES, PLM ou d’outils documentaires.
Expérience en Business Process Modeling (BPM).

Title: Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Main purpose

We are looking for a Quantitative Analyst to join our team. This is an exciting new opportunity to work on XVA and working capital models as well as contributing to a Quant Library in a dynamic and leading commodity house. As part of the job, you'll be developing and maintaining methodologies and quantitative tools, and liaising with stakeholders across the business (Traders, MO, Risk, Finance, Credit, IT). You will have strong interaction with traders and be part of the daily process of assessing the risk associated to every new transaction.

Key responsibilities

Developing and maintaining methodologies and quantitative tools

Liaising with stakeholders across the business (Traders, MO, Risk, Credit, IT) Assess the risk (CVA and FVA) associated to every new transaction

Required qualifications

3+ years working experience, preferably in an XVA quantitative business in commodity

Very strong analytical and mathematical skill

Comfortable with derivatives modelling concepts

Strong Python and/or C++ programming skills & experience

Experience in delivering production quality code, including use of source control, continuous integration, unit and regression testing

Preferred qualifications

Knowledge of working capital / cash at risk models within physical commodity space would be a plus

Master’s or higher numerate degree in Maths, Engineering, Physics, Science, Finance, or related field

Attributes for success

Ownership: Takes full responsibility for models, methodologies, and outputs, ensuring accuracy, robustness, and timely delivery in a high-impact environment

Attention to Detail: Demonstrates precision and rigor when developing, reviewing, and maintaining quantitative models and data

Communication: Clearly explains complex quantitative concepts to traders and non-technical stakeholders, supporting informed decision-making

Organizational Skills: Effectively manages multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders while maintaining high standards of documentation and governance

Resilience: Performs well under pressure in a fast-paced trading environment, adapting quickly to changing priorities and market conditions

Analytical Thinking: Applies strong problem-solving skills to assess risk, interpret model outputs, and translate analysis into commercial insight

The Market Liquidity Risk team plays a critical role in assessing and managing the liquidity, funding, and valuation risks arising from Trafigura’s global trading activities.

du Freude daran hast, komplexe Probleme strukturiert zu analysieren und datenbasierte Lösungen zu entwickeln.
du fundierte Kenntnisse in Data-Analytics-Methoden, Datenarchitekturen und Reporting-Lösungen mitbringst.

du sicher mit gängigen Analytics-Tools arbeitest, z. B. Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, Qlik Sense oder SAP Analytics Cloud.
du gerne mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeitest und komplexe Inhalte verständlich vermitteln kannst.
du über Beratungs- oder Projekterfahrung verfügst und eine pragmatische, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mitbringst.

As the Senior Product Quality Intelligence Specialist, you will be responsible for transforming post-market product data into actionable business intelligence that drives product improvements, reduces quality risks, and protects consumer trust. Experience working with large, complex datasets and developing scalable data models.

Title: Equipment Management Database Specialist (EP-CMS-SSI-2026-166-LD)
Description:
Job Details

Company Description

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, physicists and engineers are probing the fundamental structure of the universe. Using the world's largest and most complex scientific instruments, they study the basic constituents of matter - fundamental particles that are made to collide together at close to the speed of light. The process gives physicists clues about how particles interact, and provides insights into the fundamental laws of nature.

Job Description

Introduction

The role is responsible for ensuring that all equipment installed or removed during CMS Long Shutdown 3 (LS3) is accurately recorded in the CMS Equipment Management Database (EMdb). Acting as the interface between the physical inventory and the database, the post-holder ensures data consistency, maintains and enhances the database and its associated applications, and develops tools to improve data visualisation and accessibility. The role combines strong IT expertise with an understanding of the CMS experiment's equipment and asset management processes. Title: Business Intelligence Engineer (M/F)- Geneva
Description:
Main responsibilities:

As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you will support business units in analysing their reporting and data utilisation needs in order to aid decision-making. You will design, develop and maintain dashboards and Business Intelligence solutions, whilst contributing to the continuous improvement of the company’s data strategy.




You will be part of a dynamic and expert team, where you will be encouraged to put forward innovative ideas, develop new concepts and play an active role in strategic projects.




Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI.

Gather, analyse and translate business requirements into relevant reporting solutions.

Recommend improvements to optimise Business Intelligence processes and tools.

Help define the product vision and data strategy.

Monitor, control and troubleshoot daily data processing operations.

Support strategic projects in your capacity as a Business Intelligence specialist.

Ensure the quality, consistency and reliability of the data made available to users.

Draft and maintain technical and functional documentation for BI processes.

Collaborate with business and technical teams to ensure that solutions meet users’ needs.




Education:

Higher education qualification (university or university of applied sciences) in:

Computer Science, Engineering, Data & Analytics, or an equivalent field.




Experience:

At least 5 years’ experience in Business Intelligence.

Experience in the banking or financial sector would be an advantage.




Proficiency in Microsoft BI technologies:

SQL Server (T-SQL)

SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)

SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS)

SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)

Power BI




A good understanding of decision-making architectures, data flows and analytical models is required.




Soft skills:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently and a sense of responsibility.

Initiative and a focus on continuous improvement.

Ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with both business and technical stakeholders.

Team spirit and a focus on internal customers.




Languages:

Fluent English & Portuguese(essential).

Fluency in French or German is an asset, depending on the company’s context.




Technical environment:

Microsoft Power BI

Microsoft SQL Server

T-SQL

SSIS

SSAS

SSRS

Data Warehouse / Business Intelligence environment

Title: Risk & Compliance Analytics Engineer
Description:
Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 900 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units and include the Communications, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Strategy & Projects, and Tax departments.

You will join the Risk & Compliance Data Office, which aims to be the trusted and innovative data partner for the Group’s Risk & Compliance community. The unit empowers informed decision making and proactive risk management through cutting edge technology, scalable platforms and high-quality data. Its mission is to deliver reliable, well-governed and forward-looking data solutions that meet evolving regulatory requirements, foster data driven insights and enable confident, strategic decision making.

This position will initially focus more strongly on data engineering, supporting the evolution of Risk & Compliance data platforms and the migration of data and analytics capabilities to Snowflake. As with all Analytics Engineers, the role is expected to evolve over time in response to business needs and team priorities.

Your role


Working with risk managers, compliance officers and executive leadership to translate strategic goals and regulatory requirements into robust, high-quality data products, including analytics, dashboards and reporting solutions.
Acting as a trusted data advisor to stakeholders, providing guidance and support to ensure effective use of analytics and reporting, while translating ambiguous business requirements into clear, actionable technical specifications.
Taking end-to-end ownership of business themes by proactively driving initiatives that align data solutions with business needs and deliver measurable value, from data source to executive insight.
Developing the architecture and managing the end-to-end value chain for risk and compliance data verticals, ensuring that the resulting analytics and reports can be used across the Group.
Designing and rolling out precise, executive-ready metrics and interactive dashboards that stand up to regulatory scrutiny and support the Group’s strategic risk posture.
Driving the modernisation and streamlining of legacy business logic by migrating and automating solutions into modern data architectures and cloud platforms, as well as implementing innovative approaches, such as AI, intelligent agents and automation, to enhance analytics capabilities.
Ensuring rigorous data quality and controls in line with the Group's data governance framework in order to maintain the integrity of mission-critical risk and compliance data.
Managing high-volume, time-sensitive ad hoc requests and complex regulatory reports autonomously and resiliently.
Proactively engaging with stakeholders to anticipate their needs, identifying opportunities for data-driven improvements and championing best practices in analytics and reporting.
Contributing to cross-functional initiatives to align the Risk & Compliance community and the Group on data governance, data strategy, data literacy and best practices.


Your profile


A master’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Engineering or a related field. Advanced certifications (e.g. FRM or CFA) would be a plus.
At least five years’ experience in a high impact data role, such as Data Engineering, Data Analytics or AI/ML, including hands-on expertise.
Expert-level proficiency in SQL and Python, including the design, maintenance and orchestration of modern ETL/ELT workflows.
Experience with Snowflake and modern cloud-based data platforms would be a strong asset.
Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms such as Tableau, Power BI or equivalent.
Knowledge of risk management, compliance, banking operations and/or regulatory reporting would be an advantage.
Entrepreneurial and “can‑do” attitude, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast‑paced matrix environment.
Strong communication, problem solving, organisational, interpersonal and project management skills.
Excellent command of French and English, both written and spoken.
Must be resident in Switzerland, or willing to relocate.


Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Ref.: R&CAE/MH/JC

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Title: Data Scientist (m/f/d) - Reporting & Analytics
Description:
Your role in our team

As a Data Scientist (m/f/d), you will drive data-driven decision-making across our organization. You will design and develop new data products for our service business, with a particular focus on company-wide reporting. In the future, you will also support organizational development through the introduction and application of process mining tools for process analysis and optimization.

In addition, you will be responsible for further data-related development initiatives and provide valuable insights through your analyses to support strategic decision-making. Your work will strengthen a data-driven culture and enable data-powered services, giving you a direct impact on the success of the entire organization.



Design and develop data models based on SAP Datasphere
Create analytical dashboards and reports with defined KPIs in SAP Analytics Cloud and identify optimization opportunities based on the results
Implement, document, and roll out developed data models
Lead data-driven projects and initiatives as a Project Manager or Program Manager
Build and implement a Process Mining solution to enable root cause analyses



Your profile



Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, or a related field
Strong passion for data, analytics, and business processes, combined with excellent conceptual thinking skills
Strong technical capabilities and the ability to solve complex business challenges in a structured manner
Good understanding of business contexts and the ability to identify opportunities where data analytics can improve processes and performance
Solid knowledge of data analysis methods and models
Confident working with large datasets and experienced in using databases and data visualization tools
Proficient to advanced knowledge of SQL and practical experience with SAP; knowledge of Python is an advantage
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present findings clearly, persuasively, and in a stakeholder-oriented manner



Your Benefits



Thrive in an international, collaborative and fun work environment
Meaningful and challenging responsibilities that make a difference in a fast-growing industry
Diverse opportunities for further development
Competitive compensation package
Modern office, flexible working time and remote work option

Title: LPG Analyst
Description:
As an LPG Analyst to support our global oil trading team, providing in-depth market analysis, building and updating supply and demand models, providing value-add market insights, and analyzing high-frequency indicators of market dynamics. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland.

Key Responsibilities

Collating, analysing and interpreting data to produce commodity market insights

Conduct comprehensive research and analysis on fuel oil markets, including supply/demand dynamics, pricing trends, arbitrage opportunities, and regulatory developments across major global trading hubs

Build and maintaining supply and demand models, and develop detailed market reports, presentations, and trade recommendations to inform trading strategies

Provide trade flow analysis and other ad-hoc analysis to support decision-making by senior traders and management

Collaborate closely with traders, operations teams, and other analysts to identify trading opportunities, monitor positions, and manage risk exposure

Build and maintain proprietary models and tools for market analysis, forecasting, and scenario planning.

Stay up-to-date on industry news, market intelligence, and competitor activities to provide a competitive edge

Establish strong relationships with key market participants, including refiners, suppliers, and customers, to gather market intelligence.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related quantitative field;

Minimum of 4 years of experience in commodity analysis or a related analytical role, preferably with exposure to fuel oil/refined products markets

Prior experience in commodity research, specifically in LPG analytics

Title: Market Risk - Data Engineer
Description:
Main purpose

We are looking for a highly motivated Market Risk - Data Engineer to join Trafigura’s Market Risk team at the intersection of commodity trading and cutting-edge AI. This role goes beyond traditional risk analysis: you will harness agentic AI to build automated workflows, design analytical tools, and deliver rapid, high-quality insights that directly support trading decisions across our Oil & Petroleum Products, Metals, and Power & Gas divisions. If you are passionate about building things — from polished, production-ready processes to fast, creative ad hoc analyses — and you want to do it in one of the world’s most dynamic commodity trading environments, this is the role for you.

Key responsibilities

Build Data & Analytics Solutions

Develop and maintain data pipelines that support daily market risk processes and analytics.

Design and implement tools to automate data ingestion, validation, reporting, and analysis workflows.

Build scalable solutions that improve the quality, accessibility, and timeliness of risk data.

Apply AI & Automation

Help design and deploy AI-enabled workflows that support risk analysis, reporting, and operational efficiency.

Explore and evaluate emerging AI technologies, including LLMs, automation frameworks, and agent-based solutions.

Contribute to a shared library of reusable tools and frameworks that can be leveraged across the Market Risk function.

Support Quantitative Risk Analytics

Contribute to the development and enhancement of market risk models and metrics, including:

Value-at-Risk (VaR)

Stress testing and scenario analysis

Sensitivity analysis and Greeks

P&L explain and attribution

Partner with market risk managers and traders to deliver actionable insights and analytical support.

Ensure Operational Excellence

Monitor and maintain production data pipelines and analytics processes.

Investigate and resolve data quality issues, process failures, and exceptions.

Contribute to best practices in software development, testing, monitoring, and documentation.

Support continuous improvements in system reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

Required qualifications

Minimum 2–4 years’ experience in market risk, quantitative finance, or a related analytics role within commodity trading or financial services.

Strong Python programming skills and experience building production-quality solutions.

Experience working with data pipelines, APIs, data processing frameworks, or workflow automation tools.

Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, version control, and code quality practices.

Interest in applying AI and automation technologies to solve business problems.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

Preferred qualifications

Experience in financial markets, commodities, risk management, or trading environments.

Familiarity with market risk concepts such as VaR, stress testing, sensitivities, or P&L analysis.

Exposure to AI/LLM technologies, including APIs, prompt engineering, agent frameworks, or workflow automation tools.

Experience with cloud platforms, data platforms, or modern analytics environments such as Snowflake or Databricks.

Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, or related engineering practices.

Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.

Attributes for success

Intellectually curious and self-driven, with a bias for action — you move quickly from idea to working solution without waiting to be asked.

AI-first mindset: genuinely excited by agentic AI and actively seeks opportunities to deploy it across the team’s workflows — not just as a personal productivity tool but as shared infrastructure that multiplies the team’s output.

Attention to detail: maintains rigorous accuracy when working with complex models, data, and code to minimise risk and errors in a production environment.

Communication: clearly conveys technical concepts and issues to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, enabling fast and effective decision-making.

Resilience and adaptability: remains composed under pressure — whether navigating a production incident, a tight deadline, or a rapidly shifting AI landscape — and adapts quickly without losing rigour.

Department overview

The Market Risk team is a globally integrated function embedded at the heart of Trafigura's commodity trading operations, covering Oil & Petroleum Products, Metals, and Power & Gas. We partner directly with commercial and trading teams to quantify, monitor, and manage risk exposures across the full trade life cycle — from origination through settlement. The team maintains a strong quantitative focus and is actively investing in AI and automation to enhance both the depth and speed of our risk analytics. You would join a collegial, intellectually driven group that values initiative and innovation, with significant visibility into senior leadership and direct impact on the business.

Title: Senior Digital Analytics Specialist
Description:
V-ZUG E-Commerce & Website

Unser E-Commerce & Website Team innerhalb der Omnichannel-Abteilung ist das Herzstück unserer digitalen Präsenz – und Daten sind unser Kompass. Wir gestalten und optimieren unseren Online-Kanal, treffen fundierte Entscheidungen auf Basis echter Insights und entwickeln unsere Plattform kontinuierlich weiter. Von der Web-Analytics-Infrastruktur bis zum Management-Reporting sorgen wir dafür, dass digitales Wachstum messbar, nachvollziehbar und steuerbar bleibt. Dabei arbeiten wir eng mit Digital Marketing, IT und externen Partnern zusammen – immer mit dem Ziel, dass unsere Daten nicht nur korrekt sind, sondern wirklich etwas bewegen.

Das bietet dir die Stelle


Du übernimmst die volle Ownership über die Web-Analytics-Infrastruktur einer der bekanntesten Schweizer Premiummarken: GA4, GTM (Web und Server-Side), BigQuery – du konfigurierst, steuerst und entwickelst diese Infrastruktur nicht nur, du machst sie zur verlässlichen Entscheidungsgrundlage für das gesamte Unternehmen
Du sorgst dafür, dass Datenqualität kein Zufallsprodukt ist: Mit durchdachtem Data-Layer-Design, systematischem Event-Tracking, Cross-Platform-Abgleich (GA360, Contentsquare, Heap) und konsequenter Qualitätssicherung über mehrere Properties hinweg – B2B, B2C und International – schaffst du eine Datenbasis, auf die sich alle verlassen können
Du erzählst mit Daten Geschichten, die ankommen: Dein monatliches E-Commerce-Reporting richtet sich an Stakeholder und Geschäftsleitung – klar kommentiert, visuell aufbereitet in Power BI und Looker Studio, und immer mit dem Blick für das, was wirklich zählt
Du steuerst unsere externe Analytics-Agentur mit Weitblick: Von der Anforderungsdefinition über die Qualitätskontrolle bis zur Abnahme und Budget-Koordination in Quartals-Reviews – du bist die fachliche Instanz, die den Überblick behält und klare Leitplanken setzt
Du bringst Compliance nicht als Bürde, sondern als Qualitätsmerkmal ein: Cookiebot-Administration, Consent Mode v2-Implementierung und nDSG/DSGVO-konforme Analytics-Konfiguration sind für dich selbstverständliche Teile einer sauber aufgestellten Analytics-Welt



Das bringst du für die Stelle mit


Du hast mehrjährige, handfeste Erfahrung mit GA4 auf Basis des Event-basierten Modells – eine GA4-Zertifizierung hast du bereits oder holst sie kurzfristig nach, weil dir Qualitätsstandards nicht egal sind
GTM (Web und Server-Side) sowie BigQuery-SQL beherrschst du auf fortgeschrittenem Niveau – das ist keine Kann-Angabe, das ist dein Handwerkszeug, mit dem du täglich arbeitest
Du entwickelst Dashboards in Power BI und/oder Looker Studio – aktiv, nicht passiv: Du baust, du gestaltest, du verbesserst
Du verstehst, wie Performance-Marketing-Kampagnen funktionieren: Audiences, Key Events, Conversion Tracking, erweiterte Attribution – du weisst, wo die Daten herkommen und was sie bedeuten
Du hast Erfahrung in Multi-Territory- und Multi-Language-Setups und weisst, wie man externe Dienstleister wirkungsvoll führt – mit klaren Anforderungen, konsequentem QA und verbindlicher Abnahme
Als echtes Plus zählst du GA4 360-Erfahrung, Kenntnisse in Contentsquare oder Heap, oder Fähigkeiten in Python bzw. R für datengetriebene Analysen – wer das mitbringt, kann bei uns noch mehr gestalten
Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und zuverlässig – Deadlines sind für dich keine Verhandlungssache, und Dokumentation ist für dich kein lästiges Anhängsel, sondern Teil professioneller Arbeit
Du kommunizierst proaktiv und verständlich: Komplexe Datenthemen so aufzubereiten, dass sie bei Stakeholdern ankommen – das ist eine Stärke, die du bewusst einsetzt
Du hast ein Studium (FH/Uni oder Fachschule) mit Schwerpunkt Digital Marketing, Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar abgeschlossen – oder du hast dir dein Wissen durch eine Berufsausbildung mit mehrjähriger Web-Analytics-Praxis erarbeitet. Beides zählt
Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch verhandlungssicher (Arbeitssprache), auf Englisch solide für Tool-Interfaces und Dokumentation – Französischkenntnisse sind ein willkommenes Plus



Noch nicht überzeugt? V-ZUG bietet dir mehr als nur einen Job

Als Teil der V-ZUG Familie profitierst du von zeitgemässen Anstellungsbedingungen, vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, geeigneter Infrastruktur sowie zahlreichen Angeboten und Dienstleistungen für dein persönliches Wohlbefinden.

Du arbeitest dort, wo die Perfektion unserer Produkte tagtäglich spürbar ist – von der Produktentwicklung über die Produktion bis hin zum Vertrieb. Zudem profitierst du von der direkten Verkehrsanbindung für Bus, Bahn und Auto, einem Mobilitätsbeitrag und vergünstigten Parkplätzen. Auch das Vergnügen kommt nicht zu kurz: So geniesst du im eigenen Personalrestaurant ausgewogene Menüs oder entspannst bei einer Massage im Sitzen, beides zu vergünstigten Preisen.

Wir fördern dein Wohlbefinden und deinen optimalen Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Freizeit. Innerhalb regulatorischer Rahmenbedingungen und entsprechend den Anforderungen der Arbeitsaufgaben hast du als Mitarbeiter:in der V-ZUG grösstmögliche Flexibilität. Egal, ob im Teilzeitmodell, Homeoffice oder Jobsharing – du arbeitest wann, wo und wie du am produktivsten bist.

Deine individuelle Entwicklung ist uns wichtig. Wir helfen dir dabei, deine Karriere durch kontinuierliche Aus- und Weiterbildungen, inspirierende Mentorinnen und Mentoren und eine Vielzahl an geeigneten Lernressourcen zu perfektionieren. Weiter bestehen zahlreiche Aktivitäten für ein unfallfreies und gesundes Arbeitsumfeld. So bleibst du als Profi rundum fit – heute und morgen.

Wir leben durchs Band den Grundsatz der Gleichstellung. Neben einer marktgerechten und fairen Entlöhnung trumpfen wir mit überdurchschnittlichen Sozialleistungen. Da wir auf einen Koordinationsabzug verzichten, profitieren auch Mitarbeitende mit Teilzeitarbeit von unserer Vorsorgelösung.

Eine weitere Selbstverständlichkeit ist für uns die vergünstigte Abgabe von V-ZUG Produkten an dich und deine Familienangehörigen.

Ausserdem stehen dir für deinen aktiven Ausgleich zur Arbeit vielfältige und attraktive Freizeitangebote zur Verfügung, bei welchen du von mehreren Vergünstigungen profitierst.

Als Arbeitgeberin schaffen wir eine wertschätzende Arbeitskultur, welche Neugier, neue Herangehensweisen sowie fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch das Erlernen neuer Kompetenzen fördert. Bei V-ZUG hast du die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft eines traditionsreichen Unternehmens voranzutreiben. Wir unterstützen dich dabei, dein volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Gemeinsam leisten wir täglich einen Beitrag für unsere Vision „Wir bringen Leichtigkeit in Ihr Zuhause und Kreativität in Ihre Küche“. Darauf sind wir stolz.

Wir stehen für eine bunte V-ZUG ein, indem wir Rahmenbedingungen schaffen, um von der existierenden Diversität im Unternehmen gegenseitig profitieren zu können. Was uns alle verbindet, ist der Teamgeist und die Passion für die Marke V-ZUG. Wir arbeiten eng und kollaborativ zusammen, vertrauen uns gegenseitig und begegnen unseren Mitmenschen mit Respekt und Interesse. Wir akzeptieren keinerlei Diskriminierung und sind überzeugt: Inklusion und Diversität machen unser Unternehmen stark und attraktiv. Jeder Einzelne und jede Einzelne trägt dazu bei, das „wir“ voranzubringen.

Als Arbeitgeberin verstehen wir es als Pflicht, die Mitarbeitenden für die Nachhaltigkeit zu sensibilisieren. So lancierten wir unter anderem ein Training zum Thema „Nachhaltigkeit und Ressourcenknappheit“ und starteten die V-ACT Challenge, bei welcher wir auf spielerische und aktivierende Art etwas Gutes für die Umwelt tun konnten. Darüber hinaus wurden sogenannte Awareness-Ambassadors in den Teams ernannt, welche monatliche Schwerpunktthemen vermitteln. Solche Initiativen sind nicht zuletzt eine hervorragende Gelegenheit für unsere Mitarbeitenden, eigene Anregungen für mehr Nachhaltigkeit bei V-ZUG einzubringen.


Angekommen! Wir prüfen deine Online-Bewerbung und melden uns nach deren Prüfung sofort bei dir.
Deine Bewerbung überzeugt! Nun möchten wir dich gerne kennenlernen. Du erhältst eine Einladung zum Online-Interview.
Nun geht's ans Eingemachte! Auch das Team möchte dich kennenlernen – du triffst uns im persönlichen Gespräch oder zum Schnuppern vor Ort.
Wir sind voneinander begeistert! Du bekommst ein Angebot. Wenn du damit einverstanden bist, erhältst du den Vertrag für deinen Traumjob.

Wir leben durchs Band den Grundsatz der Gleichstellung. Neben einer marktgerechten und fairen Entlöhnung trumpfen wir mit überdurchschnittlichen Sozialleistungen. Da wir auf einen Koordinationsabzug verzichten, profitieren auch Mitarbeitende mit Teilzeitarbeit von unserer Vorsorgelösung.

Eine weitere Selbstverständlichkeit ist für uns die vergünstigte Abgabe von V-ZUG Produkten an dich und deine Familienangehörigen.

Ausserdem stehen dir für deinen aktiven Ausgleich zur Arbeit vielfältige und attraktive Freizeitangebote zur Verfügung, bei welchen du von mehreren Vergünstigungen profitierst.

Als Arbeitgeberin schaffen wir eine wertschätzende Arbeitskultur, welche Neugier, neue Herangehensweisen sowie fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch das Erlernen neuer Kompetenzen fördert. Bei V-ZUG hast du die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft eines traditionsreichen Unternehmens voranzutreiben. Wir unterstützen dich dabei, dein volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Gemeinsam leisten wir täglich einen Beitrag für unsere Vision „Wir bringen Leichtigkeit in Ihr Zuhause und Kreativität in Ihre Küche“. Darauf sind wir stolz.

Wir stehen für eine bunte V-ZUG ein, indem wir Rahmenbedingungen schaffen, um von der existierenden Diversität im Unternehmen gegenseitig profitieren zu können. Was uns alle verbindet, ist der Teamgeist und die Passion für die Marke V-ZUG. Wir arbeiten eng und kollaborativ zusammen, vertrauen uns gegenseitig und begegnen unseren Mitmenschen mit Respekt und Interesse. Wir akzeptieren keinerlei Diskriminierung und sind überzeugt: Inklusion und Diversität machen unser Unternehmen stark und attraktiv. Jeder Einzelne und jede Einzelne trägt dazu bei, das „wir“ voranzubringen.

Als Arbeitgeberin verstehen wir es als Pflicht, die Mitarbeitenden für die Nachhaltigkeit zu sensibilisieren. So lancierten wir unter anderem ein Training zum Thema „Nachhaltigkeit und Ressourcenknappheit“ und starteten die V-ACT Challenge, bei welcher wir auf spielerische und aktivierende Art etwas Gutes für die Umwelt tun konnten. Darüber hinaus wurden sogenannte Awareness-Ambassadors in den Teams ernannt, welche monatliche Schwerpunktthemen vermitteln. Solche Initiativen sind nicht zuletzt eine hervorragende Gelegenheit für unsere Mitarbeitenden, eigene Anregungen für mehr Nachhaltigkeit bei V-ZUG einzubringen.

Title: Manager Customer Success - Data & Governance
Description:
Deine Aufgaben


Datenqualität und Governance: Du sorgst für saubere, einheitliche Daten in der zentralen Datenablage sowie in CRM und ERP, treibst die Datenbereinigung voran und etablierst klare Standards. Als Key User kennst du unsere Systeme im Detail
Reporting und Dashboards: Du spezifizierst aussagekräftige Auswertungen und Dashboards (Power BI), stimmst die Anforderungen mit Technology ab und treibst die Automatisierung des operativen Reportings für das Team und die C&R Unit voran – die technische Umsetzung liegt bei Technology
Transparenz über Leistung und Auslastung: Du schaffst Transparenz über operative Kennzahlen – zum Beispiel Auslastung, Bearbeitungszeiten oder Datenqualität – als Grundlage für Steuerung und Ressourcenplanung
KPI-Framework mitgestalten: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team und den angrenzenden Bereichen ein tragfähiges Kennzahlen-Framework. Vieles ist hier noch im Aufbau – du prägst es mit
Data Steward und Schnittstellen: Als Data Steward des Bereichs C&R bündelst du das Datenthema. Du lieferst die Datengrundlage für die strategische Messung der Kundenzufriedenheit (Marketing) und für das Customer Journey Design (Propositions) und arbeitest eng mit dem Technology Team zusammen, damit Erkenntnisse an die richtigen Stellen fliessen
Insights-to-Action: Du erfasst Kundensignale strukturiert und stellst sicher, dass daraus konkrete Verbesserungen entstehen
Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing für die Segmentierung: Du arbeitest mit Marketing an der Kundensegmentierung


Das bringst du mit


Ausbildung: Abschluss einer Universität oder Fachhochschule mit datenorientierter Ausrichtung (z.B. Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Betriebswirtschaft mit Analytics-Schwerpunkt, Statistik oder vergleichbar)
Datenkompetenz: Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Spezifikation von Reportings und Dashboards, insbesondere mit Power BI. Grundkenntnisse in SQL (Structured Query Language, zur Abfrage von Datenbanken) oder die Bereitschaft, dich einzuarbeiten
Analytisches Verständnis: Du erkennst Zusammenhänge in Daten und übersetzt sie in klare, nachvollziehbare Erkenntnisse fürs Business
Arbeitsweise: Strukturiert, sorgfältig und gewissenhaft. Du arbeitest gerne eigenständig und bringst Themen aktiv voran
Zusammenarbeit: Du kommunizierst offen, arbeitest gerne über Teams hinweg und hast Freude daran, eine Funktion mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln
Sprachen: Deutsch und Französisch


Von Vorteil


Vertiefte Kenntnisse in Power Query (Datenaufbereitung) und DAX (Data Analysis Expressions, die Formelsprache in Power BI)
Erfahrung mit CRM- und ERP-Systemen sowie mit Datenbereinigung über mehrere Datenquellen
Erfahrung mit Prozessgestaltung und Lean Management
Englisch und Italienisch


Du erfüllst nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns ist die Person wichtiger als die lückenlose Checkliste – vieles lässt sich bei uns lernen.

Was wir bieten


Eine Schlüsselrolle im Aufbau eines der führenden E-Mobility-Unternehmen der Schweiz
Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust die Funktion Data & Governance von Grund auf mit und prägst sie
Eine Entwicklungsperspektive hin zur fachlichen Führung der Funktion
Ein motiviertes, mehrsprachiges Team und eine Kultur, in der Eigeninitiative zählt
Moderner Arbeitsort in Zürich Altstetten mit flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen

Actif.ve.s en Suisse occidentale, nous aidons nos client.e.s à réaliser leurs projets en fournissant des solutions énergétiques globales, efficaces et durables, qu’il s’agisse de production et de distribution d’électricité et de chaleur, d’installations électriques, de domotique, de mobilité douce, de climatisation ou de traitement de l’eau. Employeur exemplaire, nous soutenons le développement des compétences de nos 2450 collaborateurs.trice.s, dont 245 apprenti.e.s, ainsi que la conciliation entre vie privée et professionnelle.
La Direction Finances et informatique apporte son expertise dans la gestion financière de l’entreprise, des achats et du patrimoine ainsi que les services informatiques.

Mission :

  • Garantir la qualité, la fiabilité et la gouvernance des données achats afin de fournir une base solide pour les décisions stratégiques ;
  • Concevoir et développer des tableaux de bord, indicateurs de performance et analyses (spend, économies, prévisions) pour accompagner le pilotage des achats ;
  • Identifier les opportunités d'amélioration continue et automatiser les processus grâce à des solutions digitales (Power Automate, RPA, ERP D365) ;
  • Assurer le rôle de Key User du module Achats de l'ERP en apportant un support de niveau 2 et en participant aux évolutions des outils et aux phases de tests ;
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Achats, IT, Finance et métier afin d'harmoniser les données, de coordonner les besoins et de garantir la cohérence des processus à l'échelle du Groupe ;
  • Assurer la cohérence et la mise à jour de la bibliothèque documentaire achats, ainsi que préparer et coordonner les audits internes et externes en garantissant la conformité, la traçabilité et la disponibilité des informations.

Profil :

  • Bachelor en Informatique de gestion, en Économie d'entreprise ou formation jugée équivalente ;
  • Expérience dans un environnement Achats et/ou dans la création de tableaux de bord et d'outils de reporting, un atout ;
  • Excellente maîtrise de Power BI, Excel avancé (Power Query), SQL, Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations et de la suite Microsoft Office ;
  • Esprit analytique, rigueur, autonomie, sens de l'organisation et aisance à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés.

Ce que nous vous offrons :

  • Un environnement évolutif et favorable à l’équilibre entre la vie professionnelle et privée.
  • Les prestations sociales d’une entreprise moderne, une équité de traitement, des possibilités de développement professionnel.
  • Un fort esprit de cohésion et une équipe fière de collaborer : « Ensemble pour l’énergie de demain »

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Nuova opportunità in AXA Partners Italy.

Unisciti a noi come Data Analyst e diventa una figura chiave nel nostro team IT, Data & AI di Roma. In questo ruolo dinamico avrai la straordinaria opportunità di trasformare dati complessi in insight fruibili, guidando decisioni strategiche e promuovendo l'innovazione in AXA Partners.

Cosa Farai

La tua missione sarà trasformare i dati in valore per il business, guidando l'intero ciclo di vita delle iniziative di Analytics e Data Science. Sarai responsabile della progettazione e dell'evoluzione di dashboard e reportistica avanzata, della generazione di insight strategici e dell'applicazione di tecniche analitiche evolute, incluse Machine Learning, modellazione predittiva e analisi delle serie temporali.

Lavorerai a stretto contatto con stakeholder nazionali e internazionali, comprendendone esigenze e obiettivi per tradurli in soluzioni data-driven ad alto impatto. Attraverso un'efficace combinazione di data visualization, storytelling e competenze analitiche, supporterai il processo decisionale, contribuendo concretamente alla crescita della cultura del dato e all'innovazione all'interno di AXA Partners.

Sarai Al Centro Della Nostra Strategia Dati, Contribuendo a

Progettare, sviluppare e mantenere dashboard, reportistica avanzata e analisi ad hoc, trasformando i dati in insight strategici a supporto dei processi decisionali aziendali.

Realizzare analisi approfondite sfruttando datamart, cubi analitici e fonti dati eterogenee, valorizzando tecniche di data visualization e data storytelling per favorire la comprensione e l'adozione degli insight.

Garantire l'affidabilità, la coerenza e la qualità dei dati attraverso attività di monitoraggio, validazione e gestione proattiva degli incidenti relativi agli strumenti e ai processi analitici.

Definire, implementare e promuovere standard metodologici, framework analitici e best practice per migliorare l'efficacia e la scalabilità delle soluzioni di analytics.

Contribuire alla diffusione di una cultura data-driven, condividendo competenze, supportando i team aziendali nell'interpretazione dei dati e favorendo l'adozione di approcci basati su evidenze quantitative.

Partecipare attivamente alle community e alle guild di Data & AI Analytics, contribuendo all'innovazione continua, alla sperimentazione di nuove tecnologie e alla crescita delle competenze interne.

Collaborare con stakeholder di business e team multidisciplinari lungo l'intero ciclo di vita delle iniziative data-driven, dall'identificazione delle esigenze fino al rilascio delle soluzioni analitiche e predittive.

Applicare tecniche avanzate di Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning e analisi delle serie temporali per sviluppare modelli in grado di generare valore e supportare decisioni strategiche.

Industrializzare, distribuire e monitorare modelli e algoritmi in ambiente di produzione, garantendone performance, affidabilità e miglioramento continuo nel tempo.

Facilitare workshop e momenti di confronto interfunzionale, traducendo concetti tecnici complessi in raccomandazioni chiare e actionable per interlocutori non tecnici.

Sviluppare una profonda conoscenza del patrimonio informativo aziendale e dei processi di business, identificando opportunità di innovazione e assicurando l'integrazione efficace delle soluzioni dati all'interno dell'ecosistema AXA Partners.

Supportare la definizione di casi d'uso avanzati e la misurazione del valore generato dalle iniziative di Analytics e AI, contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi strategici dell'organizzazione.

Cerchiamo Un/a Professionista Con

Esperienza e Formazione:


3-5+ anni di comprovata esperienza in un ruolo di Data Analyst, Data Scientist o simile ruolo quantitativo.
Laurea Magistrale in Informatica, Statistica, Matematica o Ingegneria.
Certificazioni preferenziali: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300), Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100), Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900), Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), Data Engineering Solutions Using Azure Databricks (DP-750).


Competenze Tecniche Essenziali


Business Intelligence & Data Visualization: Elevata competenza nell'utilizzo di Power BI per la progettazione e lo sviluppo di dashboard interattive, reportistica avanzata e KPI framework. Solida esperienza nella modellazione dati, nell'ottimizzazione delle performance e nell'utilizzo di DAX per la costruzione di metriche complesse e analisi self-service orientate al business.
Data Science & Big Data Analytics: Esperienza pratica nell'utilizzo di Databricks per attività di data preparation, exploratory data analysis, feature engineering e sviluppo di modelli avanzati di Machine Learning su dataset di grandi dimensioni, sfruttando architetture distribuite e framework Big Data.
Cloud Data Platform & Data Engineering: Solida conoscenza dell'ecosistema dati Microsoft Azure, con esperienza nell'utilizzo di Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Databricks e Unity Catalog per la gestione, l'orchestrazione, la governance e la valorizzazione del patrimonio informativo aziendale.
Programmazione e Advanced Analytics: Ottima padronanza di Python (Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, Scikit-learn), Scala e R per attività di analisi dati, automazione, modellazione statistica, Machine Learning e sviluppo di soluzioni data-driven scalabili ed efficienti.
Database Management & SQL: Competenze avanzate in SQL per interrogazione, trasformazione e ottimizzazione dei dati, con esperienza nella progettazione di query complesse, data modeling e gestione di ambienti relazionali e analitici ad alte prestazioni.
Version Control & Collaborative Development: Familiarità con Git e con le principali pratiche di versioning, collaborazione e gestione del ciclo di sviluppo del codice, a supporto di workflow strutturati e processi di delivery affidabili.
Data Architecture & Governance: Conoscenza delle principali tematiche di data governance, data quality, metadata management e data lineage, garantendo affidabilità, tracciabilità e conformità dei dati lungo l'intero ciclo di vita delle soluzioni analitiche.
End-to-End Analytics Delivery: Capacità di operare lungo l'intera catena del valore del dato, dalla raccolta e preparazione delle informazioni fino alla produzione di insight, dashboard e modelli predittivi, assicurando un approccio integrato tra Analytics, Data Engineering e Data Science.


Competenze Analitiche e Di Data Science


Modellazione Avanzata e Data Science: Solida preparazione statistica e consolidata esperienza nell'applicazione di tecniche di Machine Learning supervisionato e non supervisionato, incluse regressione, classificazione, clustering e segmentazione avanzata. Competenza nello sviluppo di modelli predittivi e nell'analisi di serie temporali, con particolare attenzione alla validazione, interpretabilità e generazione di valore per il business.
MLOps e Industrializzazione dei Modelli: Esperienza nell'implementazione e nella gestione del ciclo di vita delle soluzioni di Machine Learning, dalla prototipazione al rilascio in produzione. Conoscenza dei principi e delle pratiche MLOps, inclusi deployment, monitoraggio delle performance, gestione del drift dei modelli, automazione dei processi e manutenzione continua per garantire affidabilità, scalabilità e sostenibilità delle soluzioni AI.
Data Storytelling e Insight Communication: Comprovata capacità di trasformare analisi complesse e risultati quantitativi in insight chiari, significativi e orientati all'azione. Abilità nel combinare data visualization, storytelling e comprensione del contesto di business per supportare il processo decisionale e massimizzare l'impatto delle iniziative di Analytics e Data Science sugli stakeholder


Soft Skills


Comunicazione e Collaborazione: Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato) e italiano (madrelingua), con comprovata abilità nel tradurre concetti tecnici complessi in messaggi chiari e orientati al business. Forte predisposizione alla collaborazione in contesti multidisciplinari, internazionali e multiculturali, favorendo l'allineamento tra funzioni tecniche e stakeholder di business.
Adattabilità e Resilienza: Capacità di operare con efficacia in ambienti dinamici e in continua evoluzione, gestendo simultaneamente priorità multiple, scadenze sfidanti e cambiamenti organizzativi. Approccio resiliente e orientato ai risultati, mantenendo elevati standard qualitativi anche in contesti ad alta pressione.
Proattività e Problem Solving: Spiccata attitudine proattiva e forte orientamento al problem solving, con capacità di anticipare esigenze, identificare opportunità di miglioramento e proporre soluzioni innovative basate sui dati. Consolidata esperienza nella gestione delle relazioni con stakeholder a diversi livelli organizzativi, bilanciando aspettative, obiettivi di business e vincoli tecnici. Elevato grado di autonomia, accountability e orientamento al raggiungimento dei risultati.
Pensiero Critico e Orientamento al Valore: Forte capacità analitica e di pensiero critico, con approccio strutturato alla risoluzione dei problemi e attenzione alla generazione di valore per il business attraverso insight data-driven e soluzioni innovative.


Cosa Offriamo

L'opportunità di entrare a far parte di un contesto internazionale, dinamico e orientato all'innovazione, dove il contributo individuale ha un impatto concreto sulle decisioni di business.

Un percorso di crescita professionale continuo, supportato da programmi di formazione, certificazioni, mentoring e confronto con professionisti del settore Data & AI.

La possibilità di lavorare su progetti strategici ad alto valore aggiunto, utilizzando tecnologie e piattaforme all'avanguardia nell'ambito Analytics, Cloud e Artificial Intelligence.

Unisciti a noi come Data Analyst e diventa una figura chiave nel nostro team IT, Data & AI di Roma. In questo ruolo dinamico avrai la straordinaria opportunità di trasformare dati complessi in insight fruibili, guidando decisioni strategiche e promuovendo l'innovazione in AXA Partners.

Cosa Farai

La tua missione sarà trasformare i dati in valore per il business, guidando l'intero ciclo di vita delle iniziative di Analytics e Data Science. Sarai responsabile della progettazione e dell'evoluzione di dashboard e reportistica avanzata, della generazione di insight strategici e dell'applicazione di tecniche analitiche evolute, incluse Machine Learning, modellazione predittiva e analisi delle serie temporali.

Lavorerai a stretto contatto con stakeholder nazionali e internazionali, comprendendone esigenze e obiettivi per tradurli in soluzioni data-driven ad alto impatto. Attraverso un'efficace combinazione di data visualization, storytelling e competenze analitiche, supporterai il processo decisionale, contribuendo concretamente alla crescita della cultura del dato e all'innovazione all'interno di AXA Partners.

Sarai Al Centro Della Nostra Strategia Dati, Contribuendo a

Progettare, sviluppare e mantenere dashboard, reportistica avanzata e analisi ad hoc, trasformando i dati in insight strategici a supporto dei processi decisionali aziendali.

Realizzare analisi approfondite sfruttando datamart, cubi analitici e fonti dati eterogenee, valorizzando tecniche di data visualization e data storytelling per favorire la comprensione e l'adozione degli insight.

Garantire l'affidabilità, la coerenza e la qualità dei dati attraverso attività di monitoraggio, validazione e gestione proattiva degli incidenti relativi agli strumenti e ai processi analitici.

Definire, implementare e promuovere standard metodologici, framework analitici e best practice per migliorare l'efficacia e la scalabilità delle soluzioni di analytics.

Contribuire alla diffusione di una cultura data-driven, condividendo competenze, supportando i team aziendali nell'interpretazione dei dati e favorendo l'adozione di approcci basati su evidenze quantitative.

Partecipare attivamente alle community e alle guild di Data & AI Analytics, contribuendo all'innovazione continua, alla sperimentazione di nuove tecnologie e alla crescita delle competenze interne.

Collaborare con stakeholder di business e team multidisciplinari lungo l'intero ciclo di vita delle iniziative data-driven, dall'identificazione delle esigenze fino al rilascio delle soluzioni analitiche e predittive.

Applicare tecniche avanzate di Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning e analisi delle serie temporali per sviluppare modelli in grado di generare valore e supportare decisioni strategiche.

Industrializzare, distribuire e monitorare modelli e algoritmi in ambiente di produzione, garantendone performance, affidabilità e miglioramento continuo nel tempo.

Facilitare workshop e momenti di confronto interfunzionale, traducendo concetti tecnici complessi in raccomandazioni chiare e actionable per interlocutori non tecnici.

Sviluppare una profonda conoscenza del patrimonio informativo aziendale e dei processi di business, identificando opportunità di innovazione e assicurando l'integrazione efficace delle soluzioni dati all'interno dell'ecosistema AXA Partners.

Supportare la definizione di casi d'uso avanzati e la misurazione del valore generato dalle iniziative di Analytics e AI, contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi strategici dell'organizzazione.

Esperienza e Formazione:

  • 3-5+ anni di comprovata esperienza in un ruolo di Data Analyst, Data Scientist o simile ruolo quantitativo.
  • Laurea Magistrale in Informatica, Statistica, Matematica o Ingegneria.
  • Certificazioni preferenziali: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300), Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100), Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900), Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), Data Engineering Solutions Using Azure Databricks (DP-750).

Competenze Tecniche Essenziali

  • Business Intelligence & Data Visualization: Elevata competenza nell'utilizzo di Power BI per la progettazione e lo sviluppo di dashboard interattive, reportistica avanzata e KPI framework. Solida esperienza nella modellazione dati, nell'ottimizzazione delle performance e nell'utilizzo di DAX per la costruzione di metriche complesse e analisi self-service orientate al business.
  • Data Science & Big Data Analytics: Esperienza pratica nell'utilizzo di Databricks per attività di data preparation, exploratory data analysis, feature engineering e sviluppo di modelli avanzati di Machine Learning su dataset di grandi dimensioni, sfruttando architetture distribuite e framework Big Data.
  • Cloud Data Platform & Data Engineering: Solida conoscenza dell'ecosistema dati Microsoft Azure, con esperienza nell'utilizzo di Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Databricks e Unity Catalog per la gestione, l'orchestrazione, la governance e la valorizzazione del patrimonio informativo aziendale.

  • Data Architecture & Governance: Conoscenza delle principali tematiche di data governance, data quality, metadata management e data lineage, garantendo affidabilità, tracciabilità e conformità dei dati lungo l'intero ciclo di vita delle soluzioni analitiche.

Competenze Analitiche e Di Data Science

  • Modellazione Avanzata e Data Science: Solida preparazione statistica e consolidata esperienza nell'applicazione di tecniche di Machine Learning supervisionato e non supervisionato, incluse regressione, classificazione, clustering e segmentazione avanzata. Competenza nello sviluppo di modelli predittivi e nell'analisi di serie temporali, con particolare attenzione alla validazione, interpretabilità e generazione di valore per il business.
  • MLOps e Industrializzazione dei Modelli: Esperienza nell'implementazione e nella gestione del ciclo di vita delle soluzioni di Machine Learning, dalla prototipazione al rilascio in produzione. Conoscenza dei principi e delle pratiche MLOps, inclusi deployment, monitoraggio delle performance, gestione del drift dei modelli, automazione dei processi e manutenzione continua per garantire affidabilità, scalabilità e sostenibilità delle soluzioni AI.
  • Data Storytelling e Insight Communication: Comprovata capacità di trasformare analisi complesse e risultati quantitativi in insight chiari, significativi e orientati all'azione. Abilità nel combinare data visualization, storytelling e comprensione del contesto di business per supportare il processo decisionale e massimizzare l'impatto delle iniziative di Analytics e Data Science sugli stakeholder

Soft Skills

  • Comunicazione e Collaborazione: Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato) e italiano (madrelingua), con comprovata abilità nel tradurre concetti tecnici complessi in messaggi chiari e orientati al business. Forte predisposizione alla collaborazione in contesti multidisciplinari, internazionali e multiculturali, favorendo l'allineamento tra funzioni tecniche e stakeholder di business.
  • Adattabilità e Resilienza: Capacità di operare con efficacia in ambienti dinamici e in continua evoluzione, gestendo simultaneamente priorità multiple, scadenze sfidanti e cambiamenti organizzativi. Approccio resiliente e orientato ai risultati, mantenendo elevati standard qualitativi anche in contesti ad alta pressione.
  • Proattività e Problem Solving: Spiccata attitudine proattiva e forte orientamento al problem solving, con capacità di anticipare esigenze, identificare opportunità di miglioramento e proporre soluzioni innovative basate sui dati. Consolidata esperienza nella gestione delle relazioni con stakeholder a diversi livelli organizzativi, bilanciando aspettative, obiettivi di business e vincoli tecnici. Elevato grado di autonomia, accountability e orientamento al raggiungimento dei risultati.
  • Pensiero Critico e Orientamento al Valore: Forte capacità analitica e di pensiero critico, con approccio strutturato alla risoluzione dei problemi e attenzione alla generazione di valore per il business attraverso insight data-driven e soluzioni innovative.

Laurea Specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria Matematica, Ingegneria delle Telecomunicazioni, Informatica, Statistica, Ingegneria Gestionale o discipline affini (STEM)

Conoscenza dei principali servizi dei Cloud provider (Google Cloud Platform, Azure, AWS) normalmente coinvolti nel disegno di piattaforme di BI (BigQuery, DataFlow, Synapse Anaytics, Azure Analysis Services, Data Factory, Data Bricks, ecc)
Ottima conoscenza e competenza in ambito SQL
Conoscenza fluente di italiano e inglese

Capacità di realizzare stored procedure e SQL function
Conoscenza di impostazione di flussi in Cloud Composer nella Google Cloud Platform
Esperienza in progetti che utilizzano modelli di AI (Gemini, OpenAI, altro) che servono a generare insights dei dati. 
MS Excel avanzato (VBA programming)
SAS Base/Guide, Python, R, Java, C++, Javascript/HTML, PHP
Certificazione in almeno un prodotto di BI tra Looker, PowerBI, Tableau, QlikSense, SAP Analytics Cloud,
